job_description:
This role will begin accepting applications on October 30, 2026, targeting cohort starts between April and August 2027*.* You must complete your application \*before\* end of day on November 24, 2026 to be considered. Thank you in advance for your patience while our team reviews all applications. All applicants will be notified by the end of Spring 2027 with an update.

* + In the “Resume" section, attach an updated CV or resume. No cover letter needed.
  + In the “Higher education" section, fill out the fields accordingly and select “Now attending or Graduated” under "Degree status." Then, upload a current or recent unofficial or official transcript in English.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Currently enrolled in or graduated from a degree program within Product Management, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Internship or Teaching Assistant experience in product management, software development or a similar technical field.
* Experience leading entrepreneurial efforts or outreach within organizations while building cross-functional relationships.
* Experience preparing and delivering technical presentations to an audience through internships, coursework, or extracurriculars.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with methodologies aimed to drive product development and delivery.
* Experience applying Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) concepts to build products or features through relevant internship, capstone projects, or other academic work.
* Technical experience with programming languages, data analysis, business case/modeling, pricing, or design.
* Ability to start full-time in the primary cohort onboarding cycle between April and August 2027.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support cross-functional business relationships in the region.
* Excellent problem-solving, organizational, investigative, and critical thinking skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google aims to build products that organize the world's information and make it universally accessible to our users. As a Product Manager at Google, you could be working on new technologies, platforms, consumer facing products, and/or enterprise systems. The end goal will be to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, experience, and where you will have the most impact.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Understand markets and user requirements in depth.
* Launch products and features, test their performance, and iterate quickly.
* Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and User Experience (UX) on technologies.
* Develop innovative solutions to problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Senior Product Manager - Managed Security Services
job_description:
**#RunwiththePack**
===================

  

At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to **end cyber risk** .

  

We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.

  

More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.

  

We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

**About the Position:**
=======================

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a **Senior Product Manager - Endpoint Security Cloud Platform** to be part of making that happen.

**Position Overview**

The Senior Product Manager, Endpoint Security Cloud Platform will own the cloud backend capabilities that underpin Arctic Wolf’s Endpoint Security portfolio, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, and agent lifecycle management. Based in Bangalore, India, this is a technical, product-facing role that partners closely with Engineering and Architecture to define requirements, make product decisions, and deliver at scale. The role will be central to two of the team’s most significant initiatives: defining the cloud side of our unified agent strategy, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into a single agent and a single cloud; and planning and executing the migration of several million endpoints from one cloud backend to another.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Ownership – Cloud Platform**

* Own the product definition, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for Endpoint Security cloud backend capabilities, including administration, policy and configuration management, device registration and enrollment, multi-tenancy, and agent lifecycle management (deployment, upgrade, and health).

* Translate Endpoint Security strategy into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, partnering with Engineering and Architecture on system design, data flows, APIs, and technical trade-offs.

* Serve as product owner for one or more development teams, owning the definition, prioritization, and hygiene of the backlog from concept through delivery.

* Partner with UX to define administrator and operator workflows that are simple, scalable, and consistent across the Endpoint Security portfolio.

  

**Agent Consolidation & Cloud Migration**

* Define the cloud-side requirements for the unified agent initiative, consolidating four endpoint agents and two cloud backends into one agent and one cloud, including feature parity, data model alignment, and deprecation sequencing.

* Plan and drive the migration of several million endpoints between cloud backends, including migration strategy, phasing, rollback and risk mitigation, customer and partner impact, and success criteria.

* Work with Engineering, Managed Services, Support, and Customer Success to ensure migrations are seamless for customers, partners, and security analysts.

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as the product point of contact for cloud platform capabilities across Engineering, Security Research, Managed Services, Support, and Customer Success.

* Ensure endpoint cloud capabilities integrate with Arctic Wolf’s broader platform and managed security services, improving analyst workflows, detection and response outcomes, and the customer experience.

* Engage directly with customers, partners, and internal users to gather first-hand requirements, validate solutions, and understand operational challenges at scale.

* Brief Endpoint Security product leadership on roadmap status, delivery plans, and risks, and provide technical input to Product Marketing as needed.

  

**Metrics & Quality**

* Define and track product success metrics for cloud platform capabilities, spanning deployment and adoption, migration progress, platform reliability and performance, product quality, and customer satisfaction.

  

**Key Qualifications**

**Experience & Expertise**

* 5+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years as a product manager at an endpoint security vendor (EPP, EDR, or XDR).

* Demonstrated ownership of a technically complex endpoint security product through multiple stages of its lifecycle, ideally including the cloud management console or backend services that administer endpoint agents.

* Experience working in high-growth organizations with globally distributed product and engineering teams.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  

**Technical Acumen**

* Sufficient technical depth to make product decisions involving endpoint agents, agent-to-cloud communication, device enrollment and identity, policy distribution, telemetry pipelines, and operating-system considerations across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

* Strong understanding of cloud-native SaaS architecture, including multi-tenant services, APIs, microservices, identity and access management, and public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

* Ability to understand customer IT environments, company products, and services at a system, data flow, and API level.

* Hands-on experience with agile development practices and serving as product owner for engineering teams.

  

**Product Skills & EQ**

* Strong decision-making and follow-through, including defining the problem, evaluating alternatives and trade-offs, and measuring results against success criteria.

* Highly detail oriented, with the ability to manage complex dependencies across multiple teams and workstreams.

* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical concepts to engineers, leadership, and customers.

* High EQ and a collaborative approach to partnering across functional teams and time zones.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading large-scale endpoint or cloud migrations, product consolidation, or re-platforming initiatives.

* Experience with device management, enrollment, or provisioning at scale (e.g., MDM/UEM or similar).

* Prior hands-on technical background, such as software engineering, solutions architecture, or sales engineering, before moving into product management.

**On-Camera Policy**

To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

**Benefits**
============

  

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:

  

* Equity for all employees
* 18 days annual leave, flexible holidays & festivals, and paid volunteer days
* Training and career development programs
* Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical insurance for you and your family, life insurance (3x compensation), and personal accident insurance.
A modern workplace in Helios Business Park in Bengaluru  

**Security Requirements**
=========================

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

  

**Your next big opportunity starts here — apply today and help us end cyber risk.**
===================================================================================

title: Associate Director - Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability
job_description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose**

The Associate Director - Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability is responsible for maximising the value of a specific Product by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Senior Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability guides Product Analysts and works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead.
* Co-create the product vision and roadmap with the business and own the value case, including the expected benefits and how they are measured.
* Own and manage the Product backlog, ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
* Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the Product Manager or Product Domain Lead (clear RACI boundary).
* Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Product Analysts and working with Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
* Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
* Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes follow required security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.
* Shape design trade-offs with Solution Architects, and scout emerging capability on the product platforms, bringing a short ranked opportunity list into backlog refinement.
* Act as an escalation point for the Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by the Product Manager and Domain Lead.
* Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile, iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact.
* Own and prioritise the AI product backlog, translating Engineering, EHS and Sustainability needs into clear AI use cases, epics, features and acceptance criteria.

**Job Purpose:**

  

**How This Differs from Traditional Product Management**
========================================================

This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you:

* Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems.
* Work with probabilistic systems, defining evaluations, acceptable error, and human oversight.
* Help lead a bionic pod, deciding which work goes to engineers and which to AI agents and workers, and how they hand off.

Prototype hands on and are measured on business outcomes

  

* Owns the Orchestration and Automation platform tower and its roadmap.
* Takes consolidation decisions across the low and medium code platform estate.
* Acts as the platform consultant for business teams building on the estate.

Owns the governance model that defines what a citizen developer may build unsupervised

**Responsibilities**:

  

**Platform Portfolio & Consolidation**
--------------------------------------

* **Map capability against actual usage** across the whole low and medium code estate, and recommend what consolidates, what stays, and what retires.
* **Quantify value rigorously.** Build credible business cases that survive finance and senior business unit scrutiny — cycle time saved, manual effort removed, licence cost avoided, automations running in production.
* **Develop deep automation pattern recognition** so you can spot the workflows worth automating and the ones that should be fixed at source instead.

**Strategic Prioritization & Portfolio Shaping**
------------------------------------------------

* **Shape the platform roadmap.** Maintain a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritized platform work, with the rationale for each decision, and feed it into the broader AI Platforms & Tools portfolio.
* **Make trade-off recommendations.** When two business sponsors both want platform investment, define the success metrics, run the analysis, and recommend where effort goes.
* **Protect engineering focus.** Push back — with evidence — on opportunities that won’t move scalable outcomes.

**Required Skills:**

  

* 16+ years of progressive experience in enterprise platform leadership, with a meaningful part of it spent owning a platform or platform estate end to end: roadmap, architecture direction, operations, and lifecycle.
* Demonstrated track record of taking a platform from fragmented or underused to well run: consolidation calls made, adoption grown, and the operating model that sustained it.
* Experience running a platform in a regulated enterprise, with working knowledge of at least one part of the pharma value chain and the data, decisions, and constraints inside it.
* Solid technical fluency in modern AI/ML, covering LLMs, agentic systems, AI agents and workers, data and evaluation patterns, sufficient to set architecture direction, challenge engineers, scope realistically, and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Experience leading engineers directly while also leading a far larger citizen developer community through influence, frameworks, and quality of thinking.
* A platform product heritage: roadmap shaping, lifecycle and version management, vendor and licensing ownership, service levels, and stakeholder alignment across a large and varied user base.

**Preferred skills**:

  

* Deep, hands-on Microsoft Power Platform experience is mandatory: Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse at enterprise scale, including environment strategy, ALM, licensing, and the governance model around them.
* Has owned a low or medium code automation platform at enterprise scale and run a citizen developer or self-service programme covering thousands of users, with guardrails that held under pressure.
* Fluent with the wider low and medium code agent and workflow stacks that sit alongside Power Platform, such as Copilot Studio, n8n, and the equivalents from the major cloud vendors.

**Skills**

AI Platforms, Change Management, Data Analysis, Microsoft ALM, Microsoft Power Apps, Microsoft Power Automate, Microsoft Power Platform, Roadmap Development, Statistical Analysis, User Needs Analysis

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

* Manage product risks, technical debt, dependencies and obsolescence, ensuring decisions and escalations are documented and addressed through the appropriate governance forums.
* Drive adoption and operational readiness by ensuring business change, training, support model, documentation, release communications and onboarding needs are reflected in plans.
* Promote iterative, user-centred and data-led ways of working and create a culture focused on measurable outcomes, learning, simplification and continuous improvement.
* Identify and prioritise AI opportunities based on business value, user needs, data readiness, technical feasibility, risk and total cost of ownership.
* Define the product vision, roadmap, outcomes and investment case for AI-enabled capabilities across Engineering, EHS and Sustainability.

job_description:
**Overview**
------------

Come join the QuickBooks Desktop team (part of Mid-Market Segment) as a Senior Staff Product Manager, AI Migration & Onboarding Agent.

QuickBooks is Intuit's flagship accounting software, powering millions of small and mid-sized businesses globally. The Mid-Market team is driving a critical transformation: migrating customers from Desktop to cloud-native platforms.

Today, migration from desktop to cloud is high-friction and high-touch. It slows conversion and strains support capacity. Your mission is to change that by building an AI Agent that guides customers through the entire migration journey, from readiness assessment to data migration, configuration, and first productive use.

This is a zero-to-one role. You will own the vision, strategy, and execution for this agent, working at the intersection of LLMs, agentic architectures, and accounting domain knowledge to turn migration from a barrier into a growth engine.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the AI Migration Agent end-to-end: Define vision, strategy, and roadmap for an AI agent that guides customers through complex product migrations, from readiness assessment through post-migration validation.
* Design for scalability and reuse: Architect the agent as a modular platform capability that can be extended to multiple source systems, customer segments, and net-new onboarding journeys.
* Define AI/Human collaboration: Design patterns where the agent handles routine tasks autonomously and escalates complex decisions to domain experts, support teams, or customers.
* Build the knowledge backbone: Own the agent's knowledge base, including product mapping logic, feature parity data, gap analysis rules, and domain-specific reasoning.
* Drive adoption and migration velocity: Define success metrics (completion rate, time-to-value, CSAT, support deflection) and build feedback loops to continuously improve agent performance.
* Lead cross-functional execution: Align engineering, AI/ML, design, data science, sales, care, and operations around an agent-first migration strategy. Partner with platform teams to leverage shared AI infrastructure.
* Close the customer insight loop: Research migrating customers, domain experts, and internal teams to uncover friction points and benchmark against AI-driven migration experiences in SaaS and Fintech.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years in product management with 2+ years shipping AI agent, conversational AI, or intelligent automation products in B2B SaaS or Fintech.
* AI Agent expertise: Deep understanding of agentic architectures, LLMs, RAG systems, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation pipelines. Experience defining guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human-in-the-loop escalation patterns.
* B2B SaaS Migration experience: Track record building customer migration, data portability, or onboarding products. Understands the complexity of moving business-critical data between systems at scale.
* Platform thinking: Designs modular, reusable agent capabilities that serve multiple source systems, customer segments, and journey types.
* Customer empathy: Deep experience with SMB/mid-market customers. Understands the friction and anxiety customers face when switching business-critical software.
* Analytical rigor: Comfortable defining and tracking agent performance metrics like accuracy, task completion, escalation rate, and time-to-value.
* Cross-functional influence: Proven ability to align engineering, AI/ML, design, and GTM teams around a shared product vision in a matrixed organization.
* Education: Undergraduate degree required (technical discipline preferred). MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Preferred

* Hands-on experience with LLM-based agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and AI evaluation techniques.
* Experience in accounting, ERP, or financial software domains.
* Top-Tier or International MBA or other Advanced degree preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Additional Location(s):** India-Haryana, Gurgaon

**Diversity - Innovation - Caring - Global Collaboration - Winning Spirit - High Performance**

At Boston Scientific, we’ll give you the opportunity to harness all that’s within you by working in teams of diverse and high-performing employees, tackling some of the most important health industry challenges. With access to the latest tools, information and training, we’ll help you in advancing your skills and career. Here, you’ll be supported in progressing – whatever your ambitions.

**Diversité - Innovation - Bienveillance - Collaboration mondiale - Esprit gagnant - Bienveillant - Haute performance**

Chez Boston Scientific, nous vous donnerons l’opportunité d’exploiter tout ce qui est en vous en travaillant dans des équipes d’employés diversifiés et hautement performants, pour relever certains des défis les plus importants de l’industrie de la santé. Grâce à l'accès aux derniers outils, informations et formations, nous vous aiderons à faire progresser vos compétences et votre carrière. Ici, vous serez accompagné dans votre progression - quelles que soient vos ambitions.

**Location:**

Gurgaon

**About the position:**

Manage the commercial performance of the business from the point of view of revenue, market share and profitability. With additional inputs for strategic and Tactical planning, Project management, Product Life cycle management, Business Analytics, Budgeting and forecasting experience.

**Primary Job Functions:**

  

* Developing and implementing marketing plans for the country according to overall Urology plan and budget.
* Portfolio Strategy & business development planning
* Leading Product Launch and Life Cycle Management in collaboration with sales leadership, local and APAC/global cross-functional stakeholders.
* Analysis of competitor activities, customer needs, technology and infrastructure, therapy adoption etc. and implement Campaigns to drive Portfolio as per division’s goals.
* Engaging with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate and further the achievements of business goals.

**Job Responsibilities**

  

* Strategically managing all aspects of internal and external marketing strategy
* Conceptualize and Lead execution of marketing plans for Urology as per Business goals and budgets, coordinate with internal functions, customers and external service providers, monitor on ground execution of programs/ conferences/ events/ promotions etc the right set of metrics are in place for tracking success.
* Planning and implementing Product launches and Product life cycle management.
* Monitoring sales performance and effectiveness of marketing programs against goals set.
* Product Life cycle management and working with cross functional teams to drive product approvals, inventory planning and product availability as per portfolio marketing plans.
* Conduct analysis of competitor activities, customer needs, technology and infrastructure, therapy adoption
* Development of key marketing communications for portfolio, works closely with agencies and media to develop right messaging and its delivery, tracking the effectiveness of the communication to drive differentiation.
* Establish relationships with KOLs in the field, Drive KOL and customer engagement
* Conduct investigative research to assess brand image, market share and growth opportunities.

**Must Have:**

  

* MBA in marketing
* 5+ Years of exp is required in Medical devices and marketing. Experience of working in marketing / product management function.
* Candidate should have handled some product launches independently
* Strong interpersonal communication skills, written and presentation skills and the ability to manage multiple programs at once and effectively prioritize work are essential.
* Candidate should have experience in Product marketing & Digital marketing
* Proficiency in excel, power point and Microsoft tool
* Candidate with Sales experience or experience in Urology will be a preference but not a limitation
* Experience of working, interacting with KOLs / physicians.
* Experience of working with cross functional teams – finance, sales, regulatory, legal in a corporate environment
* Travel requirement approx. 7-10 days a month.

**Requisition ID**: 637135

The anticipated compensation and the value of core and optional employee benefits offered by Boston Scientific (BSC) – see www.bscbenefitsconnect.com-will vary based on actual location of the position and other pertinent factors considered in determining actual compensation for the role. Compensation will be commensurate with demonstrable level of experience and training, pertinent education including licensure and certifications, among other relevant business or organizational needs.

Compensation for hourly, non-sales roles may also include variable compensation from time to time (e.g., any overtime and shift differential) and annual bonus target (subject to plan eligibility and other requirements).

Compensation for salaried, non-sales roles may also include variable compensation, i.e., annual bonus target and long-term incentives (subject to plan eligibility and other requirements).

Compensation for sales roles is governed by Sales Incentive Compensation Plan (which includes certain annual non-discretionary incentives based on predetermined objectives).

Our organization is across Canada and has commercial representation in 140 countries.

This job involves regular collaboration with colleagues, clients, and stakeholders across Canada, the U.S., and/or internationally, making proficiency in English essential for effective communication and alignment. English is necessary for engaging with a range of documentation and maintaining effective communication if interacting with external clients or vendors.

As detailed in the job description, this job involves communicating, both verbally and in writing, with other Boston Scientific teams located across Canada, the United States and/or with our international clients and partners. International customers and partners represent an important part of our activities. Based on an evaluation, we have determined that the duties of Product Manager position require knowledge of English in addition to French (oral and written). We also determined that the English language skills already required of other employees do not permit the performance of English language skills tasks related to Product Manager position.

However, in Québec, Boston Scientific limits as much as possible the number of positions for which it requires the knowledge of another language than French. Boston Scientific solely requires proficiency in English where it is necessary for the performance of an employee’s duties.

Boston Scientific transforms lives through innovative medical technologies that improve the health of patients around the world. As a global medical technology leader for more than 45 years, we advance science for life by providing a broad range of high-performance solutions that address unmet patient needs and reduce the cost of healthcare. Our portfolio of devices and therapies helps physicians diagnose and treat complex cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, oncological, neurological and urological diseases and conditions. Learn more at www.bostonscientific.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

**D de la requête**: 637135

Salaire minimum: 1400000 $

Salaire maximum: 3280000 $

La fourchette de rémunération prévue et la valeur des avantages sociaux de base et optionnels offerts par Boston Scientific (BSC) – voir www.bscbenefitsconnect.com – varieront en fonction de l’emplacement réel du poste et d’autres facteurs pertinents pris en compte pour déterminer la rémunération réelle pour ce rôle. La rémunération sera proportionnelle au niveau d’expérience et de formation démontré, à la formation pertinente, incluant les licences et les certifications, ainsi qu’à d’autres besoins organisationnels ou opérationnels pertinents.

La rémunération pour les rôles horaires et non-ventes peut également inclure une rémunération variable de temps à autre (par exemple, des heures supplémentaires et une prime de quarts de travail) et une prime cible annuelle (sous réserve de l’admissibilité au régime et d’autres exigences).

La rémunération pour des postes salariés et non-ventes peut également inclure une rémunération variable, c.-à-d. une prime annuelle cible et des incitatifs à long terme (sous réserve de l’admissibilité au régime et d’autres exigences).

La rémunération des postes liés à la vente est régie par le plan de rémunération des ventes avec incitatifs (qui comprend certains incitatifs annuels non discrétionnaires fondés sur des objectifs prédéterminés).

Notre organisation est présente partout au Canada et dispose d’une représentation commerciale dans 140 pays.

Ce poste implique une collaboration régulière avec des collègues, des clients et des parties prenantes partout au Canada, aux États-Unis et/ou à l’international. La maîtrise de l’anglais est donc essentielle afin d’assurer une communication et une coordination efficaces. La connaissance de l’anglais est nécessaire pour consulter divers documents et maintenir une communication efficace lors d’interactions avec des clients ou des fournisseurs externes.

Comme indiqué dans la description de poste, ce poste exige de communiquer, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit, avec d’autres équipes de Boston Scientific situées partout au Canada, aux États-Unis et/ou avec nos clients et partenaires internationaux. Les clients et partenaires internationaux représentent une part importante de nos activités. À la suite d’une évaluation, nous avons déterminé que les fonctions du poste de Product Manager exigent la connaissance de l’anglais, en plus du français (à l’oral et à l’écrit). Nous avons également déterminé que les compétences en anglais déjà exigées des autres employés ne permettent pas l’exécution des tâches nécessitant l’utilisation de l’anglais qui sont liées au poste de Product Manager.

Toutefois, au Québec, Boston Scientific limite autant que possible le nombre de postes pour lesquels la connaissance d’une langue autre que le français est exigée. Boston Scientific exige la maîtrise de l’anglais uniquement lorsqu’elle est nécessaire à l’exercice des fonctions de l’employé.

Boston Scientific transforme des vies grâce à des technologies médicales novatrices qui améliorent la santé des patients partout dans le monde. Chef de file mondial dans le domaine des technologies médicales depuis plus de 45 ans, nous faisons progresser la science au service de la vie en offrant une vaste gamme de solutions hautement performantes qui répondent aux besoins non comblés des patients et contribuent à réduire les coûts des soins de santé. Notre portefeuille de dispositifs et de traitements aide les médecins à diagnostiquer et à traiter des maladies et affections complexes dans les domaines cardiovasculaire, respiratoire, digestif, oncologique, neurologique et urologique. Pour en savoir plus, consultez www.bostonscientific.com et suivez-nous sur LinkedIn.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Title: Product Manager**

**Location: Gurgaon, Onsite**

**Interview: Virtual**

**Experience: 8-12 Years**

**Employment Type: Full-Time**

**Budget: 25 LPA, Flexible**

**Local to NCR, Immediate Joiner (Serving Notice Only)**

**Preferred Previous MNC Exp**

Key Responsibilities

* Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring features, initiatives, and user stories are clearly defined, refined, and prioritized.

* Define product roadmaps and priorities aligned with HNW (High Net Worth) business objectives and technology strategy.

* Collaborate with Business, Product, Technology, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, dependencies, and expected outcomes.

* Translate business needs and opportunities into actionable product requirements and measurable outcomes.

* Lead backlog refinement and prioritization in collaboration with Business Analysts, Product Owners, Technology teams, and Agile squads.

* Drive Agile execution and delivery by ensuring clarity of scope, acceptance criteria, priorities, and business outcomes.

* Facilitate stakeholder discussions to resolve competing priorities, requirements, and delivery dependencies.

* Track and communicate product progress, risks, dependencies, and key decisions to relevant stakeholders.

* Identify process improvement opportunities and establish meaningful metrics to measure product effectiveness and delivery performance.

job_description:
**Job description**

**We're hiring**

**Product Manager E-commerce, CRO & AI Products**

Own the customer journey for CrazyNeon, a fast-growing custom signage brand serving customers across the US and beyond. This role blends e-commerce product thinking, conversion optimization, data, and applied AI — not a typical roadmap-and-tickets PM job.

Propound Internet Pvt. Ltd.Gurgaon **On-siteProduct & Growth4–8 yearsFull-time**

**About CrazyNeon**

CrazyNeon is a fast-growing e-commerce brand specializing in custom LED neon signs and other custom signage, selling to customers across the US and other international markets. It's owned and operated by Propound Internet Pvt. Ltd.

We're building the next generation of the custom signage buying experience — combining e-commerce, technology, design, automation, and AI.

**About the role**

We're looking for a Product Manager who's genuinely obsessed with the customer journey, conversion rates, and building better digital experiences.

This isn't a traditional PM role focused mainly on managing a software roadmap. You'll identify opportunities across the CrazyNeon website and customer journey, figure out why customers convert or drop off, test and ship improvements, and work closely with design, technology, marketing, sales, and operations to make them happen.

A meaningful part of the role is also forward-looking: exploring and building new AI-powered products and experiences that change how customers design, customize, buy, and interact with custom signage.

*The ideal candidate combines e-commerce, CRO, product thinking, data analytics, technology, and AI — in one person.*

**What you'll do**

**1. E-commerce product management**

* Own and continuously improve the CrazyNeon digital customer journey, from landing page to purchase.
* Identify friction points across product discovery, customization, pricing, artwork submission, design approval, checkout, and post-purchase.
* Build and maintain a product roadmap based on business impact and customer needs.
* Work with technology, design, marketing, sales, and operations to execute improvements.
* Find opportunities to improve customer experience, revenue, average order value, and conversion.
* Track competitor websites and emerging e-commerce experiences for ideas worth adapting.

**2. Conversion rate optimization**

CRO is a major part of this role.

* Own the website's conversion optimization roadmap end to end.
* Analyze the full funnel and pinpoint where and why customers drop off.
* Use analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, customer feedback, and A/B testing to diagnose problems.
* Turn findings into testable hypotheses, then design and prioritize experiments.
* Partner with UI/UX and development to ship tests, measure results, and roll successful ones into permanent improvements.

Areas you'll optimize include: landing pages, product pages, product customization, pricing presentation, calls to action, trust signals, reviews and social proof, quote/inquiry flows, artwork upload, design approval, cart, checkout, lead-generation forms, and mobile experience.

Over time, you should develop a sharp, evidence-backed understanding of what actually makes a customer buy custom signage online — and keep improving that journey.

**3. Data & analytics**

* Use data — not just intuition — to identify product and conversion opportunities.
* Monitor conversion rate, revenue per visitor, average order value, add-to-cart rate, checkout conversion, lead-to-order conversion, customer acquisition cost, repeat purchase rate, funnel drop-off, and product-level performance.
* Build dashboards and reports that keep the team honest about what's working.
* Translate data into concrete, actionable product recommendations.
* Set up measurement frameworks for every new launch or experiment.

**4. Customer research**

* Build a deep understanding of CrazyNeon's customers and how they buy.
* Mine customer inquiries, support conversations, sales feedback, reviews, and abandoned carts for product opportunities.
* Run customer interviews and usability studies where useful.
* Spot recurring problems that technology, automation, better UX, or new products could solve.
* Turn customer problems into clear product requirements.

**5. AI & new-age products**

A key part of this role is identifying and building AI-powered products and experiences for CrazyNeon — and continuously exploring how AI can improve both the customer experience and internal operations.

Potential areas include:

* AI-powered custom neon/sign designer and design generation
* AI artwork analysis and preflight
* AI-powered product recommendations, search, and discovery
* AI-assisted quoting and configuration
* AI-powered customer assistance and sales tools
* AI-assisted artwork-to-production workflows
* AI-powered personalization and customer mockup generation
* Internal AI knowledge systems for employees

You'll be responsible for spotting high-value AI opportunities, evaluating new AI technologies and platforms, defining MVPs and requirements, working with developers, AI engineers, designers, and outside vendors, testing with real customers, measuring adoption and impact, and taking what works from prototype to production.

*You don't need to be an AI engineer — but you should be technically curious, and comfortable understanding what modern AI can and can't actually do.*

**6. Product strategy & roadmap**

* Maintain a prioritized roadmap based on revenue impact, customer value, effort, and strategic importance.
* Turn business problems into clear product requirements, briefs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Take products from idea MVP launch optimization, in step with engineering and design.
* Set KPIs for every major initiative.

**7. Experimentation & innovation**

We want someone who's constantly asking: *"What can we do differently?"*

* Track new e-commerce technologies and trends, and study companies doing e-commerce and AI well.
* Identify technologies that could give CrazyNeon a real edge.
* Prototype quickly, and test ideas before committing serious development resources.
* Help build a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement.

**What we're looking for**

**Must-have**

* 4–8 years in e-commerce product management, growth product management, CRO, digital product management, or similar.
* Strong grasp of e-commerce customer journeys and conversion funnels.
* Hands-on experience running conversion rate optimization programs.
* Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfort with analytics platforms and user behavior tools.
* Ability to turn data and customer insight into product decisions.
* Experience working closely with developers and designers.
* Solid understanding of UX/UI principles.
* Strong communication and project management skills.
* A commercial mindset — you understand how product changes move revenue.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with D2C/e-commerce brands.
* Shopify or similar e-commerce platform experience.
* Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, VWO, Optimizely, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar.
* Experience with personalization or experimentation platforms.
* Experience building or shipping AI-powered products.
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI APIs, generative AI, computer vision, AI agents, or automation.
* Experience with custom products, configurators, or design tools.
* Experience in international (especially US) e-commerce.

**Who thrives in this role**

**Data-driven** — you look at the numbers before making product calls.

**Customer-obsessed** — you want to understand why customers behave the way they do.

**Commercially minded** — you know a product only succeeds when it creates measurable business value.

**Experimentation-oriented** — you'd rather test an idea than debate it for weeks.

**Technically curious** — you don't need to write production code, but you can work effectively with engineers and evaluate new technology.

**AI-curious** — you follow AI developments and can spot practical applications, not just hype.

**Entrepreneurial** — you're comfortable when requirements aren't fully defined, and you can build the solution rather than just execute someone else's roadmap.

**Hands-on** — you can move from customer problem hypothesis spec build launch analytics optimization, start to finish.

**How we'll measure success**

Website conversion rate

Revenue per visitor

Add-to-cart rate

Checkout conversion

Lead-to-order conversion

Average order value

Revenue from new product experiences

Adoption of new digital/AI products

Customer engagement

Number & quality of experiments run

Reduction in customer friction / manual work

**Why join CrazyNeon?**

This is a chance to build more than another e-commerce website. You'll help build the technology layer behind the next generation of custom signage commerce — AI-powered design, personalization, automation, configuration, and customer experience.

You'll have real ownership, and the chance to take ideas from concept prototype launch measurable business impact.

If you enjoy working at the intersection of data, e-commerce, product, technology, CRO, and AI — this role could be a strong fit.

**Role:** Product Manager **Industry Type:** Internet (E-Commerce)

**Department:** Product Management **Employment Type:** Full Time, Permanent

**Role Category:** Product Management - TechnologyEducation **PG:** MBA/PGDM in Advertising/Mass Communication, Information Technology, Marketing, Systems, Business Strategy

Key Skills/ Skills CRO, Product Management, Shopify plus, Product Roadmap, Funnel Analysis, D2C, GA4Clarity, Mixpanel, Product Life Cycle Management

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

* Current CTC?
* Expected CTC ?
* Notice Period?

Experience:

* Product management: 4 years (Required)

Language:

Work Location: In person

* Internal AI knowledge systems for employees

You'll be responsible for spotting high-value AI opportunities, evaluating new AI technologies and platforms, defining MVPs and requirements, working with developers, AI engineers, designers, and outside vendors, testing with real customers, measuring adoption and impact, and taking what works from prototype to production.

*You don't need to be an AI engineer — but you should be technically curious, and comfortable understanding what modern AI can and can't actually do.*

**6. Product strategy & roadmap**

* Maintain a prioritized roadmap based on revenue impact, customer value, effort, and strategic importance.
* Turn business problems into clear product requirements, briefs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Take products from idea MVP launch optimization, in step with engineering and design.
* Set KPIs for every major initiative.

**7. Experimentation & innovation**

We want someone who's constantly asking: *"What can we do differently?"*

* Track new e-commerce technologies and trends, and study companies doing e-commerce and AI well.
* Identify technologies that could give CrazyNeon a real edge.
* Prototype quickly, and test ideas before committing serious development resources.
* Help build a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement.

**What we're looking for**

**Must-have**

* 4–8 years in e-commerce product management, growth product management, CRO, digital product management, or similar.
* Strong grasp of e-commerce customer journeys and conversion funnels.
* Hands-on experience running conversion rate optimization programs.
* Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfort with analytics platforms and user behavior tools.
* Ability to turn data and customer insight into product decisions.
* Experience working closely with developers and designers.
* Solid understanding of UX/UI principles.
* Strong communication and project management skills.
* A commercial mindset — you understand how product changes move revenue.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with D2C/e-commerce brands.
* Shopify or similar e-commerce platform experience.
* Familiarity with GA4, Google Tag Manager, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, VWO, Optimizely, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar.
* Experience with personalization or experimentation platforms.
* Experience building or shipping AI-powered products.
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI APIs, generative AI, computer vision, AI agents, or automation.
* Experience with custom products, configurators, or design tools.
* Experience in international (especially US) e-commerce.

**Who thrives in this role**

**Data-driven** — you look at the numbers before making product calls.

**Customer-obsessed** — you want to understand why customers behave the way they do.

**Commercially minded** — you know a product only succeeds when it creates measurable business value.

**Experimentation-oriented** — you'd rather test an idea than debate it for weeks.

**Technically curious** — you don't need to write production code, but you can work effectively with engineers and evaluate new technology.

**AI-curious** — you follow AI developments and can spot practical applications, not just hype.

**Entrepreneurial** — you're comfortable when requirements aren't fully defined, and you can build the solution rather than just execute someone else's roadmap.

**Hands-on** — you can move from customer problem hypothesis spec build launch analytics optimization, start to finish.

**How we'll measure success**

Website conversion rate

Revenue per visitor

Add-to-cart rate

Checkout conversion

Lead-to-order conversion

Average order value

Revenue from new product experiences

Adoption of new digital/AI products

Customer engagement

Number & quality of experiments run

Reduction in customer friction / manual work

**Why join CrazyNeon?**

This is a chance to build more than another e-commerce website. You'll help build the technology layer behind the next generation of custom signage commerce — AI-powered design, personalization, automation, configuration, and customer experience.

You'll have real ownership, and the chance to take ideas from concept prototype launch measurable business impact.

If you enjoy working at the intersection of data, e-commerce, product, technology, CRO, and AI — this role could be a strong fit.

title: Technical Product Manager - Principal
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager / Solutions Architect – Design Automation & AI Workflows**
===================================================================================

**Company Overview**  
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

**Want to Help Shape How Chips Are Designed in the Future?**

* How would you automate workflows that have traditionally required years of engineering expertise?
* How would you combine AI, optimization, and domain knowledge to solve challenging problems across analog, custom digital, and standard cell design?
* How would you help customers migrate decades of intellectual property between design environments?
* How would you create products that make engineers dramatically more productive while improving design quality?
* How would you take breakthrough ideas from concept to deployment at the world's leading semiconductor companies?

That's what we do. We're looking for people who are excited about solving difficult problems and making a meaningful impact. You'll work at the intersection of semiconductor design, AI, product strategy, and customer engagement. The ideal candidate understands complex design challenges, can translate customer needs into product requirements, and enjoys helping bring innovative technologies from concept to production.

**Responsibilities**

* Define product requirements and workflows for next-generation design automation solutions.
* Work directly with customers to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and validate proposed solutions.
* Drive product direction for technologies across analog design, standard cell design, custom digital implementation, design migration, and design automation.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to translate customer needs into product capabilities and deliverables.
* Define use cases, success metrics, benchmarks, and customer adoption strategies.
* Lead evaluations, demonstrations, customer engagements, and early-access deployments.
* Influence roadmap priorities based on market needs, customer feedback, and competitive analysis.

**Requirements**

* BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience in semiconductor design, EDA, or related technical fields.
* Experience defining solutions, workflows, or products that have been successfully delivered to users or customers.
* Experience applying automation, AI, machine learning, generative AI, or agentic AI technologies to engineering workflows.
* Strong understanding of one or more of the following domains:
  + Analog and custom IC design
  + Standard cell design and optimization
  + Physical implementation
  + Design migration and design reuse
  + Semiconductor design automation
  + Physical verification, extraction, and simulation workflows
* Experience working directly with customers to gather requirements and drive technology adoption.
* Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work effectively across product management, engineering, sales, and customer teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Analog and custom IC design workflows.
* Circuit simulation, SPICE, and analog verification flows.
* DRC, LVS, parasitic extraction, and physical verification.
* OpenAccess-based design environments.
* Experience with commercial EDA platforms such as Cadence Virtuoso.
* Delivering software products used in production semiconductor design flows.
* Technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

We are looking for product leaders who are excited by emerging technology, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to help shape the future of semiconductor design. Success in this role requires a combination of technical depth, customer focus, business judgment, and the ability to turn innovative ideas into widely adopted solutions.

**Why us?**  
Working at Siemens Software means flexibility — choosing between working at home and the office (with state-of-the-art facilities in Bangalore and Noida) at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

job_description:
**SOVOS**

**Associate Product Manager (AI-First)**
========================================

Product Management·Full-Time·India

**Build Your Future With Us**

The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.

We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.

AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.

Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.

**THE ROLE**

At Sovos, we're looking for an Associate Product Manager who will support product strategy and execution for a product area whilst taking on Product Owner responsibilities day to day. AI fluency is a core part of this role. You'll own the backlog, write sprint-ready stories, and leverage AI tools daily to research, analyse, draft, and prototype faster and more effectively. This is a global posting for India.

*More specifically, you will:*

* Own and prioritise the product backlog; keep it groomed two sprints ahead and write Jira stories with clear user story, context, acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then), and explicit out-of-scope details.
* Run sprint planning, refinement, and demos with engineering, QA, and design; accept or reject delivered work against acceptance criteria and coordinate UAT and release readiness.
* Support the Senior Product Manager on roadmaps, PRDs, and business cases; analyse usage data, support tickets, and customer feedback to identify problems worth solving.
* Work with customer success and sales to turn customer requests into validated requirements; track delivery, risks, and dependencies and report status clearly and honestly.
* Use AI tools (Claude or similar) daily for research, synthesis, drafting PRDs and stories, and analysing data; build repeatable AI workflows such as story-drafting templates or connected tools to save team time.
* Turn ideas into clickable prototypes or small internal tools using AI-assisted design or coding tools; demonstrate AI product sense by understanding LLM limits and specifying AI features with evaluation criteria and fallback behaviour.

**WHAT YOU BRING TO SOVOS**

* You've built solid experience (typically 2–3 years) in product, business analysis, or product ownership, with prior hands-on experience as both a Product Owner and in a product management role.
* Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Jira (epics, stories, sprints, boards); you're comfortable managing backlogs and running agile ceremonies.
* Clear, concise written communication skills; you can write acceptance criteria an engineer cannot misread and deliver status updates that are honest and actionable.
* Comfortable with data: you can read a dashboard and use analytics tools to answer product questions; you bring an ownership mindset and follow through without being chased.
* AI fluency is essential: you use AI tools daily, write structured prompts, catch hallucinations and weak reasoning, and understand data-privacy risks; you can show real examples of building AI workflows, rapid prototyping, and responsible AI use with company-approved tools.
* Domain knowledge in tax, compliance, or fintech is a plus, as is experience with UI prototyping tools, design systems, or evaluating and shipping AI-powered features.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.

**THE PROCESS**

We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:

**1**

**Pre-Employment Assessment**

Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.

**2**

**Video Interview**

A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.

**3**

**Meeting with a Recruiter**

A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.

**4**

**Live Interviews with the Hiring Team**

Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.

**LIFE AT SOVOS**

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* Comprehensive Health Insurance (Day 1, company paid)
* Life and Accidental Insurance (company paid)
* Hybrid Work Arrangement
* Annual Health Check-up

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

**Company Background**
----------------------

Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.

More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.

### **Ready to make your move?**

We'd love to hear from you. Use the Apply button at the top of this page to submit your application

* Holds relevant product knowledge on CASA Deposits products

• Develop and introduce new products to increase overall business profitability
  
• Focus on Balance Sheet Growth

------------------------

**Business**  
• Drive and achieve MOM Business targets (CASA, NTB and NSR) as per Budgets.
  
• Segment focus, customer focussed product and process development

**Processes:**  
• Operational quality - Error free processing of customer applications
  
• Well defined and streamlined process to drive liabilities business

**People & Talent**  
• Build a transparent and collaborative culture in which incentives are based on support of Client Income with specific performance metrics on the Bank's values.

**Risk Management**  
• Conduct CDD, MLP & TCF diligently
  
• Zero tolerance – Fraud, Mis selling
  
• Attend training, acquire knowledge and apply to job function
  
• Adhere to all policies, guidelines and procedures, comply with local regulatory requirements
  
• To comply with all applicable money laundering prevention procedures and, in particular, report any suspicious activity to the Unit Money Laundering Prevention Officer and line manager

**Governance**  
• Promote an environment where compliance with internal control functions and the external regulatory framework is a central priority of the business

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**  
**• Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.**  
**• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.**  
**• Support Business Banking – Liability Business across regions to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: [Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment.]**  
**• Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.**

**Key stakeholders**  
**• Business Banking Liabilities Team**

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

* **Business Product and Process**

**• KYC & Documentation**  
**• Business – Market Knowledge**  
**• Regulatory Guidelines and Compliance**

**About Standard Chartered**
----------------------------

**We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.**

**Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.**

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation** **, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.**
* **In line with our Fair Pay Charter** **, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.**
* **Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance** **, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.**
* **Time-off** **including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.**
* **Flexible working** **options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.**
* **Proactive wellbeing support** **through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.**
* **A continuous learning culture** **to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.**

**Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.**

title: Product Manager Senior Specialist
job_description:

**About Futureforce University Recruiting**

Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.

**Job Category**

Product

**Job Details**

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**Designation:** Product Manager Senior Specialist

**Location:** Hyderabad/Bangalore

**Job Details:**

Cracking CAT, getting into IIMs, going through the grind to complete PGP should have its rewards, right? How about an exciting and fast paced start-up work culture, the pride of working for a highly respected brand, the ability to create the bleeding edge of enterprise software technology, an opportunity to own and build a multi-billion dollar business as rewards? You guessed it right! We are talking about a Product Management position at Salesforce.

Salesforce is the fastest enterprise software company to hit a USD 10 billion revenue. We have been consistently rated as the most innovative company and the best place to work for by multiple rating

agencies. With in Salesforce, industries team is slated to be the fastest growing cloud. The Salesforce applications and industries team is hiring top Product Management professionals to drive innovation

& accelerate our growth.

As a product manager, you must be a team-player who fosters our ohana culture, a leader who leads through influence, a dreamer who pushes the limits of technology, an artist that creates beautiful

products, a doer that ships three releases in a year, an astute business man that delivers successful products to market and in short, you must be a rock-star.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Understand and analyze user needs.

* Analyze market trends, competitors, customer research, and product data to drive the overall success of the product.

* Help to define a product vision and strategy.

* Partner with designers to create an intuitive and beautiful user experience.

* Work with engineers to build proof of concept & design.

* Help evangelize product vision through presentations to stakeholders.

**Job Requirements:**

* First and Foremost: Demonstrable experience in building enterprise SaaS products

* Passion for building products with enterprise scale

* Strong Product Management skills

* Ability to work in a team of other PMs who have dependencies on you and vice versa. Others would leverage much of what you work on with corresponding needs for their functionality.

  

**Everything else that matters:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related disciplines or equivalent experience in technical roles

* Work Experience : 0-24 Months

* Plus your IIM PGP

* 2027 Graduate

* Agile methodology, and API experience

* Great sense of humor, and grace under pressure.

**Modern Tooling Acumen:**

Direct experience using and critically reviewing code and artifacts generated by large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agentic tools. Must be able to eﬀectively guide AI tools to achieve desired outcomes.

Graduates need direct experience using and critically reviewing code and artifacts generated by large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agentic tools. This is a newer requirement; candidates

who have actively experimented with and used tools like Gemini, Cursor, or other agent-based frameworks will be stronger candidates.

Salesforce, the Customer Success Platform and world's #1 CRM, empowers companies to connect with their customers in a whole new way. The company was founded on three disruptive ideas: a new

technology model in cloud computing, a pay-as-you-go business model, and a new integrated corporate philanthropy model. These founding principles have taken our company to great heights, including being named one of Forbes’s “World’s Most Innovative Company” five years in a row and one of Fortune’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” eight years in a row. We are the fastest growing of the top 10 enterprise software companies, and this level of growth equals incredible opportunities to grow a career at Salesforce. Together, with our whole Ohana (Hawaiian for "family") made up of our employees, customers, partners and communities, we are working to improve the state of the world.

  

**Posting Statement**

Salesforce.com and Salesforce.org are Equal Employment Opportunity and Aﬃrmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital

status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this Web site or directly to managers. Salesforce.com and Salesforce.org do not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Salesforce.com and Salesforce.org will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Salesforce.com or Salesforce.org.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

**Posting Statement**

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
