author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager I (Adtech)
job_description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

  
  
**Job Description**

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead products and capabilities that measure national and local television audiences across linear broadcast, cable, and streaming environments. This role sits at the intersection of media measurement, data science, technology, and client needs—turning complex viewing signals into trusted, actionable audience insights for programmers, advertisers, agencies, and other media stakeholders.

The ideal candidate understands how television is bought, sold, distributed, and measured across fragmented platforms. You will define product strategy, translate industry requirements into an actionable roadmap, and guide cross-functional teams from concept through launch and ongoing improvement.

What you’ll do

* Own product strategy and roadmap for cross-platform television audience measurement capabilities spanning national and local markets.
* Translate customer, market, and regulatory needs into clear product requirements, success metrics, and prioritized investments.
* Partner with data science, engineering, research, operations, sales, and customer success to deliver scalable, reliable measurement products.
* Drive measurement solutions across linear and streaming environments, including audience estimates, reach and frequency, impressions, demographic reporting, time-shifted viewing, and deduplicated cross-platform audiences.
* Evaluate the integration and use of viewing data from panels, return-path data, set-top boxes, smart TVs, streaming platforms, and other data sources while maintaining methodological rigor.
* Lead discovery with clients and industry stakeholders to identify unmet needs and validate product direction.
* Define operating models and quality standards that support data accuracy, comparability, transparency, and timely delivery across national and local markets.
* Communicate product vision, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
* Mentor product managers and contribute to stronger product practices, decision frameworks, and team development.

 **Qualifications**

What you bring

* 6+ years of experience in product management, media measurement, audience analytics, advertising technology, streaming, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience taking data-intensive products from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Strong understanding of television and video ecosystems, including broadcast, cable, streaming, connected TV, local markets, ad-supported programming, and media buying.
* Familiarity with audience measurement concepts such as ratings, share, reach, frequency, impressions, demographics, viewing duration, co-viewing, time shifting, and cross-platform duplication.
* Experience working with large-scale data sets, data partnerships, APIs, and/or analytical platforms; comfort partnering deeply with technical teams.
* Ability to balance methodological integrity, customer value, operational feasibility, and commercial priorities.
* Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Experience influencing without direct authority in a matrixed, cross-functional environment.

Success in this role

In the first year, you will establish a clear roadmap for cross-platform television measurement, strengthen alignment between customer needs and delivery teams, and launch improvements that increase trust, usability, and coverage across national and local audiences.

Why join us

You will help shape the next generation of television audience measurement as viewing continues to fragment across traditional and streaming platforms. This is an opportunity to influence an industry-critical product area, work with sophisticated data and technology, and make measurement more transparent, comparable, and useful for the marketplace.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

**Company Description**
-----------------------

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few.

Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site (experian.com/careers) to understand why.

**Job Description**
-------------------

As Senior Product Manager, you will lead product strategy and delivery across the Fraud and ID Agent Initiative, from the current MVP through the roadmap toward a scalable, production-ready capability. You will connect client and analyst needs with fraud expertise, data science, engineering, platform, legal, compliance, and AI governance partners. You will own the product outcomes, priorities, and decisions that keep the program useful, safe, and deliverable.

What you will do

* **Set product direction.** Define the product vision, and measurable outcomes for fraud and identity capabilities, balancing the near-term pilot with a reusable longer-term product.
* **Lead discovery with users and partners.** Work with the Brazil pilot partner and fraud specialists to understand analyst workflows, emerging fraud patterns, data needs, and what makes a recommendation actionable and.
* **Coordinate global delivery.** Align the Brazil business and data team with India-based engineering, architecture and platform teams, and partner stakeholders. Establish clear ownership, resolve blockers, and maintain a operating cadence across teams.
* **Guide responsible use of data and AI.** Partner on data access, privacy, security, AI governance, model quality, explainability, auditability, and controls. The current design uses rules and statistical methods to detect patterns, then uses an LLM to explain findings and draft recommendations.
* **Measure product performance.** Define how the team will evaluate detection quality, time to analyst review, fraud outcomes, recommendation usefulness, analyst adoption, and operational impact. Establish validation plans before expanding beyond the pilot.
* **Build the next-phase roadmap.** Use evidence from the pilot to prioritize production readiness, broader data coverage, a purpose-built analyst experience, and future client or regional expansion.
* You will report to the Senior Director of Product Management
* You will have to WFO 2 days a week as its Hybrid working

**Qualifications**
------------------

* You are required to have 8+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex, data-intensive products from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Experience in fraud, identity, payments, financial services, risk decisioning, or a closely related domain.
* Work closely with engineering and data science on data pipelines, model or rules-based systems, integrations, experimentation, and production constraints.
* Strong product judgment: you can turn an ambiguous problem into a focused roadmap, make trade-offs explicit, and connect delivery to customer and business outcomes.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders across regions, functions, and organizational boundaries.

**Preferred experience**

* Building or scaling AI/ML-enabled products, especially human-reviewed decision support or agentic workflows.
* Working with sensitive customer data, privacy or compliance reviews, model governance, and audit requirements.
* Launching products with international teams, pilot partners, or multi-client platforms.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, collaboration, wellness, reward & recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's people first approach is award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2024 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, and Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2024 to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site and Glassdoor to understand why.

Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.

job_description:
**Job Description:**

**About Us**

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

**Global Business Services**

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

  
  

**Process Overview:**

Global Banking & Markets division serves mid- to large-sized corporations and institutional clients worldwide. It is comprised of Business Banking, Global Commercial Banking, Global Corporate & Investment Banking, Global Markets and Wholesale Credit. Aligned with these client-facing groups are Global Capital Markets and Global Research. Global Banking and Markets Technology provides end-to-end technology solutions for Global Markets and banking businesses including Equities, Prime Brokerage, Interest Rates, Currencies, Commodities, Derivatives, Structured Products, Commercial Card, Cash Management, Payments, Sales, Servicing and Fulfillment. Across all these products, solutions include architecture, design, development, change management, implementation and support using various enterprise technologies.

**Job Description:**

Product owner contributes to the development of the US Wires high-value payment system. Responsible for maximizing the value delivered by the Wires Modernization product and ensuring alignment with business objectives. Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Wires Modernization initiative. Work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs, challenges, and priorities, translating them into actionable product requirements. Collaborate with the Product Manager within a scaled Agile framework to ensure alignment with broader program and organizational goals. Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring the highest-value work is delivered first. Partner with the development team to clarify requirements, remove ambiguities, and ensure stories are ready for implementation. Work closely with the functional and automation testing teams to ensure all requirements are thoroughly tested and the delivered functionality works as expected. Review and accept completed stories, making timely decisions on scope, requirements, and priorities. Communicate product goals, roadmap updates, and delivery progress to stakeholders and project teams. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive successful execution and delivery of modernization objectives. aLeverage technology solutions and business knowledge to maximize product value and achieve project outcomes.

**Responsibilities**

* Review requirements and acceptance criteria; design and execute positive, negative, integration, and end-to-end test scenarios; maintain requirements-to-test traceability; log defects and validate fixes to confirm functionality works as expected.
* Identify suitable scenarios for automation; develop and maintain automated functional, API, and regression tests; execute automated suites and analyze failures; update scripts as requirements evolve and report coverage and results.
* Coordinate with the different workstreams Product Owner and development team to clarify requirements, prepare test data and environments, confirm coverage across functional and automated tests, and communicate test results, outstanding defects, and risks to support release-readiness decisions.
  

  

**Requirements**

* **Education:** B.E./ B. Tech/M.E./M. Tech/BSC/MSC/BCA/MCA (prefer IT/CS specialization)
* **Certifications If Any:** NA
* **Experience Range:** 12-16 yrs
  

  

**Mandatory skills:**

* US wire payment knowledge
* Experience in modernization from legacy platforms
* Strong payments knowledge.
* SWIFT and ISO20022 experience

  

**Desired skills**

* Good testing exposure and exposure in working with global teams

  

**Work Timings General Shift** - 11:30 AM to 8:30 PM

  
  

**Job Location** – Chennai

job_description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**Senior Product Manager, Shipping as a Service** (L25)

  
  

**About the Team and the Role**

  
  

**eBay Shipping is evolving from a marketplace capability into a reusable global platform.** Our ambition is to make eBay's shipping services available to eBay entities and subsidiaries, external marketplaces, third-party commerce and logistics platforms, and sellers operating across multiple channels.

We are looking for a customer-obsessed Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end partner and client journey - from opportunity discovery and solution shaping through integration, launch and adoption. You will help early clients succeed while ensuring their needs are translated into scalable platform patterns rather than one-off implementations.

This role sits at the intersection of B2B product, developer experience and global go-to-market. You will work closely with eBay Shipping Product and Engineering teams, Design, Analytics, Business, Legal, Finance, Operations and partner-management teams to create a repeatable model for bringing new clients onto the platform.

  
  

**What you will Accomplish**

* Define the product strategy and roadmap for client onboarding, partner integrations and adoption of Shipping as a Service.

* Segment and prioritize target customers and use cases across eBay entities, subsidiaries, marketplaces, third-party platforms, high-volume sellers and multi-channel businesses.

* Own the complete client journey from discovery and requirements through technical integration, certification, production launch, growth and support.

* Develop repeatable integration patterns, reference journeys and onboarding playbooks that reduce time to first API call, first label and production scale.

* Partner with the Platform PM and Engineering teams to translate client needs into reusable APIs, configuration and operational capabilities.

* Shape the developer and partner experience, including documentation, onboarding, authentication and access controls, sandbox journeys, sample applications, integration checklists, and support processes.

* Work with client teams to define embedded shipping experiences that are simple, trustworthy and consistent while allowing appropriate flexibility for their customers.

* Lead cross-functional launch readiness across Product, Engineering, Business, Legal, Security, Payments, Reconciliation, Shipping Operations, Customer Support and Analytics.

* Build feedback loops with clients and partners to identify friction, prioritize improvements and continuously strengthen the platform proposition.

* Establish and own adoption metrics such as integration cycle time, activation, active clients, shipment volume, repeat usage, support contacts and partner satisfaction.

* Tell a compelling product and business story that aligns senior stakeholders around target clients, investment priorities, launch sequencing and measurable outcomes.

  
  

**What you will Bring**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally across B2B, B2B2C, marketplaces, SaaS, developer products or platform integrations.

* Experience taking complex integrations from early discovery through production launch and adoption.

* Strong customer-discovery skills and the ability to distinguish reusable platform needs from client-specific requests.

* A track record of designing effective onboarding, activation or partner experiences using qualitative insight and funnel data.

* Strong understanding of APIs and technical integrations, with the ability to work credibly with client and platform engineering teams.

title: Senior Manager, Digital Product Owner
job_description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

Digital impacts everything we do. Pfizer’s end-to-end supply chain digital strategy is focused on delivering leading-edge decision support and visibility solutions to enable improved planning and risk management. The Digital Supply & Business Development Team is looking for a Senior Manager, Digital Product Owner to own the vision, roadmap and agile delivery of digital solutions to achieve our strategic goals and business objectives.

The Senior Manager, Digital Product Owner will drive the digital vision, road mapping, and delivery of launch solutions for >300 users world-wide. This includes a growing portfolio of AI-enabled products, such as AI agents, chatbots and predictive monitoring, built on trusted enterprise data. This role will partner with business leaders to envision the product/solution’s business strategy, ensure that the product roadmap delivers the agreed vision and metrics and is aligned with the overall enterprise strategy, and manage the product lifecycle following an agile methodology. The role leads a team of product owners and product analysts together with contract delivery resources and is accountable for their performance and delivery.

As an innovation thought partner to Digital and business colleagues, this role will be counted on to identify opportunities to use established and emerging digital capabilities, including generative and agentic AI, to unlock value through converging supply chain knowledge with future technologies.

**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own the product vision, multi year roadmap, and success metrics, for the applications being delivered
* Own the AI roadmap for the launch portfolio: identify, prioritize and deliver AI use cases (agents, chatbots, monitoring and forecasting), and ensure agents are designed to work together rather than overlap
* Work with cross-functional teams of engineers and designers to deliver user-centric products
* Set priorities and make day-to-day trade-off decisions with the product owners, resolving competing demands across the launch portfolio
* Exercise a strong decision-making mandate across cross-functional teams as the accountable decision-maker for the launch product portfolio
* Lead the agile practice for the digital product portfolio, including directing scrum masters, business analysts, systems analysts, and AI engineers to drive continuous improvement in delivery predictability, quality and throughput, and promote practical use of AI tools (e.g., Copilot, AI prototyping tools) in backlog, design and documentation work
* Direct the full product lifecycle from opportunity definition through design, release and adoption, ensuring solutions meet user needs and realize the committed business value
* Partner with data owners and enterprise data teams to ensure data ownership, definitions and master data governance are in place before AI capabilities are introduced
* Define and track AI value metrics (e.g., adoption, planning time saved, manual effort reduced) and report outcomes to senior leadership
* Manage AI vendors, partners and contract resources, including build-vs-buy decisions, resource estimates and budget planning
* Ensure launch solutions, including AI-enabled solutions, are delivered and sustained in compliance with Pfizer quality, data-integrity and GxP validation requirements (where applicable) and responsible-AI governance standards, partnering with Compliance & Risk Management and Enterprise Architecture
* Serve as innovation thought partner to PGS and Digital leadership — identifying where emerging digital capabilities can unlock supply chain value, and building the business case through demos, prototypes and presentations to senior leadership to secure endorsement and funding

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related field required
* 8+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years leading teams or managing people, with pharmaceutical or healthcare experience a strong plus
* Experience delivering AI-enabled products (e.g., generative AI, chatbots, agents) from use-case definition through production
* Working knowledge of agentic AI concepts, including agent orchestration, integration with enterprise data and tools, and evaluating AI output quality
* Fluency with enterprise AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, AI prototyping tools) and ability to coach teams in using them
* Experience successfully creating and executing against product visions, strategies, and roadmaps that achieve goals and outcomes
* Exceptional at working with and analyzing user metrics and turning them into actionable insights
* A curious and highly motivated self-starter who can work effectively across cross-functional teams and can independently drive progress toward completion with proper planning and management
* Passion for creating user-centric digital and interactive experiences
* Agile/Lean Development knowledge, training or experience.
* A strong communicator with great written and verbal skills
* Up to date and knowledgeable about the latest trends, innovations and best practices in the digital space, including AI

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* MBA or Master’s degree in strategy, management, or related field is a plus
* Certification in Agile and Scrum development practices is a plus
* Experience in product design and data & analytics, including data governance and data products that feed AI solutions
* Experience managing external AI/technology vendors and working in a federated product or platform model
* ERP systems knowledge e.g. SAP (S4 HANA, IBP, MDG)

  
  
Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

Pfizer is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable equal employment opportunity legislation in each jurisdiction in which it operates.

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers.

title: Lead Technical Product Manager
job_description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Lead Technical Product Manager is responsible for defining product strategy, roadmap, and delivery execution for technology products and platforms. This role bridges business objectives and engineering capabilities to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions that drive customer and business value. The position owns product vision, backlog prioritization, stakeholder alignment, feature planning, and product performance across the product lifecycle.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Define and execute product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business goals
* Partner with engineering, architecture, UX, data, and business teams to deliver impactful product outcomes
* Manage and prioritize product backlogs, features, and user stories based on customer needs and business value
* Translate customer insights and business requirements into actionable product requirements
* Drive product planning, release management, and continuous improvement activities
* Balance customer experience, business priorities, technical constraints, and operational needs
* Lead cross-functional stakeholder discussions and facilitate alignment on priorities and tradeoffs
* Monitor product performance, adoption, and value realization using data-driven decision making
* Ensure compliance with governance, security, and enterprise technology standards
* Communicate roadmap progress, risks, and strategic direction to senior leadership
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Product Management, Software Engineering, or related technology roles
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale technology products in Agile environments
* Experience with Agile delivery tools such as Aha!, Rally, Jira, GitHub, or similar platforms
* Solid understanding of software development lifecycle, cloud technologies, APIs, data flows, and modern architecture patterns
* Proven ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive strategic outcomes

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Healthcare, payer, provider, or regulated industry experience
* Experience leading AI/ML, data, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives
* Knowledge of product operating models, OKRs, roadmap management, and value-stream delivery
* Proven solid executive communication and stakeholder management skills

**Key Competencies**

* Product Strategy & Roadmap Management
* Customer-Centric Product Development
* Technical Acumen & Systems Thinking
* Agile Product Delivery
* Stakeholder Management & Influence
* Data-Driven Decision Making
* Leadership & Team Collaboration
* Strategic Planning & Execution

**Success Measures**

* Product adoption and customer satisfaction
* Delivery against roadmap commitments
* Business value realization and outcomes
* Stakeholder satisfaction and engagement
* Product quality, reliability, and operational performance
* Team effectiveness and cross-functional collaboration

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Lead Digital Product Manager - Agentic Operations
job_description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Digital Product Manager for Agentic Operations who will lead the day-to-day management, optimization, governance, and performance of AI agents that support Marketing business operations. This role combines product ownership, operations management, AI fluency, analytics, risk management, and stakeholder engagement to ensure agentic solutions deliver reliable, measurable, and compliant business outcomes.

**In this role, you will:**

* Manage operational guardrails for agent and LLM usage, ensuring agent activity stays within defined thresholds for time, cost, risk, autonomy, escalation, and business-approved use.
* Establish and monitor controls that prevent unmanaged agent behavior, including runaway loops, excessive retries, unsupported tool use, policy exceptions, and outputs that exceed approved risk tolerance.
* Oversee the resilience of agent operations by defining fallback paths, failover routines, human-in-the-loop escalation, exception handling, and continuity plans when agents, models, tools, or knowledge sources are unavailable or degraded.
* Monitor and improve agent response-time performance across priority workflows, identifying latency drivers and partnering with technology teams to optimize routing, orchestration, caching, context handling, and service-level expectations.
* Evaluate whether the selected LLM, model, or model tier is appropriate for each task, balancing quality, complexity, latency, cost, risk, and the required level of reasoning before routing work to higher-capability models.
* Maintain visibility into token usage, model consumption, cost trends, and capacity requirements at the agent, workflow, business area, and portfolio levels.
* Translate token, cost, latency, risk, and usage data into capacity management recommendations that keep the agentic operating model aligned with business-area strategic priorities.
* Develop executive-ready reporting that communicates agent health, performance, resilience, risk posture, capacity consumption, and recommended prioritization decisions.
* Partner with product, technology, risk, compliance, analytics, and business stakeholders to refine operating standards and ensure agentic capabilities scale responsibly across the enterprise.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of digital product management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, digital product management, marketing technology, AI-enabled operations, business execution, risk management, or a related function
* 2+ years of experience managing, coaching, or directing the work of individual contributors, project teams, or cross-functional delivery partners.

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience managing or supporting enterprise marketing capabilities such as marketing automation, audience operations, campaign orchestration, personalization, customer engagement, content operations, or marketing workflow platforms.
* Experience with AI-enabled marketing operations, enterprise AI platforms, LLM-based capabilities, agent orchestration, observability tools, knowledge management, or workflow automation.
* Proficient understanding of marketing platforms, campaign operations, customer engagement capabilities, workflow orchestration, and the controls required to operate in a regulated financial services environment.
* Experience managing resources, objectives, priorities, and operating routines within a functional area, including capacity planning, performance tracking, issue resolution, and escalation management.
* Demonstrated ability to manage moderately complex to complex business, operational, technical, or risk challenges using data, sound judgment, and structured decision-making.
* Experience partnering with product, technology, analytics, compliance, risk, controls, legal, and business stakeholders to deliver outcomes while managing dependencies and risk.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to translate technical, operational, and risk concepts into clear business recommendations for managers and senior leaders.
* Ability to operate with a risk mindset, drive operational excellence, simplify processes, and hold teams accountable for quality, timeliness, and business outcomes.
* Experience applying governance, audit, privacy, information classification, responsible AI, model risk, or control expectations to digital, marketing, or technology-enabled business processes.
* Experience developing operating models, playbooks, performance scorecards, executive reporting, adoption plans, and capacity management routines for a business or platform function.
* Experience leading through ambiguity, influencing without direct authority, and aligning cross-functional partners around strategic priorities, trade-off decisions, and measurable outcomes.
* Financial services, consumer banking, lending, or regulated marketing experience.
* Experience with agile delivery practices, backlog prioritization, PI planning, Jira, product roadmaps, or cross-functional delivery routines.

**Job Expectations:**

* AI agents consistently meet defined accuracy, quality, compliance, and escalation standards.
* Agent adoption increases across priority user groups and business workflows.
* Operational issues are identified quickly, remediated effectively, and prevented through improved controls.
* Stakeholders have clear visibility into agent performance, business value, risks, and roadmap priorities.
* Agentic capabilities scale responsibly while improving productivity, speed, consistency, and decision support.

**Posting End Date:**

29 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

**We Value Equal Opportunity**

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.

**Applicants with Disabilities**

To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.

**Drug and Alcohol Policy**

Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.

**Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:**

a. Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.

b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

role: Senior Principal - SN Finance, Risk & Legal Product Owner

title: Senior Principal - SN Finance, Risk & Legal Product Owner
job_description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for a DPTF platform product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output. Products span cloud, network, digital workplace and AI Hub domains, and the specific product is set on appointment.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering. This is an insourced role under the DPTF sourcing decisions, so it is not delivered through a managed service partner.

The Product Owner leads a group of related Products, CSM for Finance and Procurement, Legal Service Delivery within the ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools Domain, ensuring they deliver measurable value, support business processes, and are continuously improved.

**Key Responsibilities**

Describe the key deliverables to be achieved by the post holder and the ongoing responsibilities of the role

* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the ServiceNow Business, Risk & Security Product Manager and the Senior Director of ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools.
* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs, and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology, engineering or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering).
* Agile or product certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Product ownership in a platform or agile environment, covering backlog management, prioritisation and increment acceptance.
* Outcome measurement, covering OKRs, adoption metrics and flow metrics used to steer delivery.

**Minimum Level of Job-Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 5 or more years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context with experience.
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.
* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.
* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.
* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.
* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standards grounds.

**Skills**

Agile Delivery, Agile Methodology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Executive Communications, Leadership Strategies, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM), ServiceNow Human Resource Service Delivery (HRSD), Software Development, Stakeholder Management, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

Business Introduction

**Job Purpose**

The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for GSK's network segmentation product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs, and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology, engineering or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering).
* Agile or product certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Product ownership in a platform or agile environment, covering backlog management, prioritisation and increment acceptance.
* Outcome measurement, covering OKRs, adoption metrics and flow metrics used to steer delivery.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 5 or more years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context.
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.
* Experience delivering segmentation capabilities as a Product Owner or equivalent member of an Agile team.
* Capability in Team Backlog prioritisation, story definition, acceptance criteria, Planning Interval events and iteration execution.
* Evidence of delivering segmentation improvements that increased policy coverage, reduced risk or enabled secure access.

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.
* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.
* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.
* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.
* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standards grounds.

Automation Technology, Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), Cloud Based Services, Cloud Networking, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Firewalls, IP Address Management (IPAM), IT Network Security, Load Balancers, Microsegmentation, Network Design, Network Segmentation, Operational Technology (OT), Operational Technology (OT) Network Segmentation Architecture, Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.  
  
**Job Purpose:**  
  
This role is positioned within the Enterprise Veeva Quality Suite - Product Team, responsible for contributing to the technical solution design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Veeva Quality Suite across Content Management, Quality, Audit & Risk business processes. The Product Owner in Veeva Quality Vault is responsible for requirements, managing advanced configuration change requests on lifecycles, workflows, atomic security settings, objects, reports, etc. and for testing and validation documentation in line with GSK’s Internal framework. The Product Owner is senior to the Product Analyst role and leads large scale configuration projects across Veeva Quality Vault. The Senior Product Owner is responsible for maximizing the value of a specific product by translating business needs into a prioritized backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Product Manager and Associated Director, Product Owner. The role works closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to product strategy. The Senior Product Owner guides Product Owner and works with Technical SMEs, Architects, Service teams and external partners to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven and data-informed. The job holder makes day-to-day backlog and acceptance decisions, oversees iterative delivery and uses product performance information to improve adoption, stability, user experience and operational readiness.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Provide product expertise in the Veeva Quality Suite as a certified Vault platform administrator and Veeva configuration specialist, leading large-scale configuration projects.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements and define product outcomes within guardrails set by the Product Managers.
* Act as the product knowledge expert across multiple objects, coaching product owners and managing configuration changes for the Veeva Quality Suite in line with agreed priority backlog items.
* Lead impact assessment activities, reviewing proposed changes and ensuring impact understood across the entire Quality Suite.
* Deliver product enhancements through agreed backlog process to ensure Veeva Quality Suite evolves to meet business needs.
* Ensure Quality Vault remains compliant as a Validated Solution through supporting testing and re- validation efforts and that configuration releases from validation to production are compliant.
* Collaborate with Veeva Enterprise Managed Services on product features and with business resources across Global Supply Chain, Research and Development, Vaccines and GSK support functions, managing and maintaining metadata in Quality Vault (including picklists and organisational data).
* Make backlog prioritization decisions based on value, cost, risk, business continuity and resource capacity, escalating strategic trade-offs in line with the agreed RACI.
* Lead refinement, demonstrations, acceptance and release decisions, maintaining clear traceability from business outcome through requirement, test and delivered change, and ensure product changes follow required security, data, quality, validation, change and regulatory controls with specialist approvals obtained where required.
* Support architects in assessing design options, managing cross-product dependencies, interface impacts and release sequencing, and act as an escalation point for the product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding resolution within agreed guardrails.
* Coordinate supplier delivery and hold external partners accountable for quality, documentation, knowledge transfer and product outcomes, promoting agile, iterative, value-driven and data-led delivery and using feedback and performance insights to continuously improve the product.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience in product ownership, agile delivery, business analysis, change, process improvement or service management certifications.
* Minimum five years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, digital solutions, technology delivery or process-led technology roles.
* Experience in defining and prioritising epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria and managing a product backlog.
* Experience in working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Experience in prioritising changes based on value, process impact, risk, cost, capacity and technology dependencies.
* Experience in guiding product analysts, engineers, architects and testers through refinement, design, testing, release and adoption.
* Experience in applying security, data protection, quality, validation, change and service-readiness controls.
* Experience in defining product performance measures and using user, process, stability and service insights to improve outcomes.
* Experience working in agile or iterative delivery environments and coordinating suppliers or external delivery partners.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Communicates product decisions and technology constraints in written and verbal form to non-technical stakeholders.
* Facilitates discovery, backlog refinement, prioritisation, demonstrations and acceptance discussions.
* Applies analytical judgement to balance value, risk, cost, complexity, urgency and operational impact.
* Interprets process information, user feedback and product data to identify and specify improvements.
* Maintains working knowledge of architecture, integration, data, security, validation, service and operational readiness.
* Maintains organisation, traceability and documentation in line with governance requirements.
* Works collaboratively across global, cross-functional and supplier teams.
* Defines solutions that are user-centred, capability-led and technology-agnostic.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Process Diagrams, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story

### **Senior Product Manager - Oracle RMCS**

* JR-164209
* Hybrid

* Bengaluru

* Technology Enablement

* Full time

**Who are we?**

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Oracle Cloud Revenue Management (RMCS) Techno-Functional Product Manager with expertise in Oracle RMCS, Subscription Management, Oracle Cloud Finance modules and AI-driven automation solutions. The ideal candidate will partner with business and IT stakeholders to design, implement, enhance, and support revenue management applications while leveraging automation and AI capabilities to improve operational efficiency, business processes, and user experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Oracle RMCS implementation, enhancement, and support initiatives.
* Gather business requirements, perform fit-gap analysis, and design scalable solutions.
* Configure and support Oracle RMCS, Subscription Management, SLA, AR, and GL modules.
* Ensure compliance with ASC 606/IFRS 15 revenue recognition standards.
* Design and support integrations with Oracle Cloud applications and external systems.
* Identify opportunities to leverageAI, automation, and analyticsto improve revenue operations, reporting, and support processes.
* Partner with business and technical teams to implement intelligent workflows, process automation, and AI-enabled solutions.
* Defines test strategy and execution approach to test specific functionality
* Design release scope and schedules aligned with business needs
* Develop test scripts and execute comprehensive test plans and procedures
* Coordinate integration testing, validate test cases with stakeholders for user acceptance testing and training, and secure necessary approvals
* Brings in best practices by keeping up-to-date with technology and vendor products
* Manage defect clarification, triage, and coordinate resolution with engineering teams
* Troubleshoot functional, technical, and integration issues and drive resolution.
* Create and maintain solution documentation, business process flows, and test scenarios.
* Collaborate with global teams and mentor junior team members.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 7+ years of Oracle ERP experience with at least 3 years focused on Oracle RMCS.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle RMCS, Subscription Management, AR, SLA and GL.
* Strong understanding of ASC 606/IFRS 15 revenue recognition principles.
* Experience with FBDI, data conversions and Oracle PL/SQL.
* Experience implementing or supporting AI-driven automation, workflow optimization, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Oracle Cloud Financials and/or RMCS Certifications
* Experience with Oracle FDI, Tableau, Salesforce OM, and reporting solutions.
* Experience with AI/ML-based business process automation tools and Oracle AI capabilities.
* Agile/Scrum delivery experience.
* Knowledge of SaaS and subscription-based business models.

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing form.

Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

**We use artificial intelligence in our hiring process. Learn more** **here****.**

This posting is for a backfill position, meaning it is to fill an existing vacancy within our organization.

job_description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Technical Product Manager to lead the strategy, design, and delivery of next-generation compliance technology solutions across traditional payments, digital assets, stablecoins, and AI-enabled compliance capabilities.

This role sits at the intersection of Compliance, Product and Technology driving the development of platforms that enable scalable compliance controls while supporting business growth and innovation. The successful candidate will possess deep expertise in Financial Crime Compliance (AML, Sanctions, KYC, Transaction Monitoring), strong knowledge of Crypto and Stablecoin ecosystems, and a passion for leveraging Artificial Intelligence to transform compliance operations.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Ownership:

* Define and execute the product vision, roadmap, and strategy for Compliance Technology platforms.
* Drive product innovation across AML, Sanctions Screening, Customer Due Diligence, Transaction Monitoring, Case Management, and Regulatory Reporting.
* Develop scalable compliance solutions supporting both traditional payment rails and digital asset ecosystems.
* Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for automation, operational efficiency, and risk reduction.

Financial Crime Compliance:

* Translate regulatory requirements into product features and technical capabilities.
* Design and enhance controls supporting:
  + AML/CFT
  + Sanctions Screening
  + KYC/KYB & Customer Due Diligence
  + Transaction Monitoring
  + Enhanced Due Diligence
  + Regulatory Reporting
  + Case Management & Investigations
* Collaborate with Compliance Operations teams to optimise alert management and investigation workflows.

Crypto & Stablecoin Compliance:

* Lead compliance technology initiatives supporting stablecoin-enabled payment products and digital asset ecosystems.
* Design controls for:
  + Blockchain analytics
  + Wallet screening
  + On-chain transaction monitoring
  + Travel Rule compliance
  + Crypto onboarding and risk assessment
  + Stablecoin transaction monitoring
* Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to embed compliance controls within digital asset products and services.
* Evaluate emerging regulatory frameworks and assess impacts on product and technology strategies.

AI & Emerging Technologies:

* Champion the application of AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Intelligent Automation across compliance programs.
* Develop AI governance, explainability, and model oversight requirements in partnership with Compliance and Risk teams.
* Evaluate AI vendors and emerging technologies to strengthen compliance capabilities.

Technical Product Delivery:

* Translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications and user stories.
* Work closely with architects and engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions.
* Lead integrations with internal platforms and external providers.
* Manage product backlogs, prioritisation, UAT, production validation, and release planning.
* Leverage data analytics to identify trends, improve performance, and enable data-driven decisions.

Stakeholder Leadership:

* Serve as the primary liaison between Compliance, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, and Commercial teams.
* Lead requirement workshops, design reviews, and governance forums.
* Influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across global teams.
* Present strategy, roadmap progress, and key decisions to executives and leadership teams.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, Compliance, or related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Compliance Technology, FinTech, Payments, or Financial Services.
* Deep understanding of:
  + AML/CFT frameworks
  + Sanctions Compliance
  + Customer Due Diligence
  + Transaction Monitoring
  + Financial Crime Investigations
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale compliance technology solutions.
* Strong knowledge of payments, money movement, and fintech ecosystems.
* Experience working within Agile product delivery environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience with Crypto, Digital Assets, Stablecoins, Blockchain Analytics, or Travel Rule solutions.
* Knowledge of stablecoin regulatory frameworks and compliance controls.
* Experience implementing AI/ML-enabled compliance solutions.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data architecture, and system integrations.
* Knowledge of ISO 20022, ISO 8583, and modern payment architectures.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated Technical Product Manager to lead the strategy, design, and delivery of next-generation compliance technology solutions across traditional payments, digital assets, stablecoins, and AI-enabled compliance capabilities.

This role sits at the intersection of Compliance, Product and Technology driving the development of platforms that enable scalable compliance controls while supporting business growth and innovation. The successful candidate will possess deep expertise in Financial Crime Compliance (AML, Sanctions, KYC, Transaction Monitoring), strong knowledge of Crypto and Stablecoin ecosystems, and a passion for leveraging Artificial Intelligence to transform compliance operations.

Key Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Ownership:

* Define and execute the product vision, roadmap, and strategy for Compliance Technology platforms.
* Drive product innovation across AML, Sanctions Screening, Customer Due Diligence, Transaction Monitoring, Case Management, and Regulatory Reporting.
* Develop scalable compliance solutions supporting both traditional payment rails and digital asset ecosystems.
* Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for automation, operational efficiency, and risk reduction.

Financial Crime Compliance:

* Translate regulatory requirements into product features and technical capabilities.
* Design and enhance controls supporting:
  + AML/CFT
  + Sanctions Screening
  + KYC/KYB & Customer Due Diligence
  + Transaction Monitoring
  + Enhanced Due Diligence
  + Regulatory Reporting
  + Case Management & Investigations
* Collaborate with Compliance Operations teams to optimise alert management and investigation workflows.

Crypto & Stablecoin Compliance:

* Lead compliance technology initiatives supporting stablecoin-enabled payment products and digital asset ecosystems.
* Design controls for:
  + Blockchain analytics
  + Wallet screening
  + On-chain transaction monitoring
  + Travel Rule compliance
  + Crypto onboarding and risk assessment
  + Stablecoin transaction monitoring
* Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to embed compliance controls within digital asset products and services.
* Evaluate emerging regulatory frameworks and assess impacts on product and technology strategies.

AI & Emerging Technologies:

* Champion the application of AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Intelligent Automation across compliance programs.
* Develop AI governance, explainability, and model oversight requirements in partnership with Compliance and Risk teams.
* Evaluate AI vendors and emerging technologies to strengthen compliance capabilities.

Technical Product Delivery:

* Translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications and user stories.
* Work closely with architects and engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient solutions.
* Lead integrations with internal platforms and external providers.
* Manage product backlogs, prioritisation, UAT, production validation, and release planning.
* Leverage data analytics to identify trends, improve performance, and enable data-driven decisions.

Stakeholder Leadership:

* Serve as the primary liaison between Compliance, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, and Commercial teams.
* Lead requirement workshops, design reviews, and governance forums.
* Influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across global teams.
* Present strategy, roadmap progress, and key decisions to executives and leadership teams.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, Compliance, or related discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Compliance Technology, FinTech, Payments, or Financial Services.
* Deep understanding of:
  + AML/CFT frameworks
  + Sanctions Compliance
  + Customer Due Diligence
  + Transaction Monitoring
  + Financial Crime Investigations
* Experience delivering enterprise-scale compliance technology solutions.
* Strong knowledge of payments, money movement, and fintech ecosystems.
* Experience working within Agile product delivery environments.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience with Crypto, Digital Assets, Stablecoins, Blockchain Analytics, or Travel Rule solutions.
* Knowledge of stablecoin regulatory frameworks and compliance controls.
* Experience implementing AI/ML-enabled compliance solutions.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data architecture, and system integrations.
* Knowledge of ISO 20022, ISO 8583, and modern payment architectures.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.
