### **Principal Product Manager - Conversational AI**

* JR-164269
* Hybrid

* Bengaluru

* Technology Enablement

* Full time

**Who are we?**

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

**Job Summary**

This is a senior individual contributor role with broad influence across the company. You will own the product strategy for Equinix's conversational AI and assistant platforms — chat, voice, and agentic interfaces that employees, customers, and partners interact with directly. You will work closely with engineering and architecture teams on technical decisions while also helping executives understand business implications, investment choices, and risk.

You will serve as a conversational AI product leader across Go to Market, Operations, Product, and Corporate functions. Depending on the initiative, you may advise business leaders, partner with product and engineering teams, or directly lead product strategy and delivery for conversational experiences and the platform capabilities that power them.

The conversational AI market is changing quickly — from single-turn chatbots to multi-agent, tool-using assistants. An important part of this role is evaluating new conversational AI technologies, identifying which capabilities are relevant to Equinix, and translating them into practical product and platform investment decisions.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

Conversational AI, Cloud, and Data Architecture

* Bring strong working knowledge of conversational AI, dialogue systems, agent orchestration, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise data architecture to product and platform decisions
* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to evaluate large language model architectures, conversational agent design patterns (orchestrator/worker, multi-agent handoff, tool calling), cloud deployment approaches, and enterprise data pipelines
* Participate meaningfully in technical and architecture reviews, as well as product and roadmap discussions for the conversational platform
* Translate technical choices, constraints, and risks into clear business implications that leaders can understand and act on
* Help ensure conversational AI products are designed for enterprise scale, security, reliability, multi-channel support (chat, voice, embedded assistants), and reuse across business functions
  

  

Conversation Design, Model Strategy, and Deployment

* Guide decisions on prompt design, retrieval augmented generation, conversation flow and dialogue management, model customization, fine tuning, and model selection for conversational use cases
* Help teams determine when a smaller model may provide better latency, cost, or control for real-time conversational interactions than a larger model
* Partner with AI and machine learning engineering teams on deployment approaches for conversational agents across cloud, private infrastructure, and low-latency environments
* Evaluate emerging approaches such as multi-agent coordination, model routing, tool/function calling, memory and context management, and hybrid model deployment for conversational systems
* Use conversation quality metrics, containment and escalation rates, model performance data, evaluation results, user feedback, and business outcomes to guide product priorities
  

  

Platform Reliability and Responsible AI

* Define product requirements for conversational AI system reliability, availability, latency, performance, monitoring, usage limits, and incident response
* Partner with engineering teams to improve visibility into conversational agent behavior, model performance, cost, conversation logs, and production issues
* Establish requirements that support traceability, explainability, auditability, fairness, privacy, and regulatory compliance across conversational interactions
* Work with Legal, Security, Privacy, and AI Governance teams to incorporate company policies and responsible AI requirements into conversational products and platforms, including data handling within chat, voice, and memory features
* Partner with Design to create clear conversational UX that explains how AI is being used, manages user expectations, and provides appropriate review, control, hand-off to a human, and approval within the conversation itself
  

  

Product Decisions and Risk Management

* Lead decisions involving tradeoffs among business value, delivery speed, technical complexity, cost, performance, and risk for conversational AI features
* Establish clear and repeatable methods for evaluating major conversational AI product and architecture decisions
* Help teams identify risks early — including hallucination, unintended actions, and improper data exposure in conversational contexts — and determine the appropriate level of governance and human oversight
* Balance the need to deliver conversational value quickly with the requirements of security, reliability, and responsible AI
  

  

Executive and Cross Functional Leadership

* Build alignment across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Legal, Information Security, Data, Design, and business functions on the conversational AI roadmap
* Influence decisions through expertise, clear reasoning, and strong working relationships rather than direct authority
* Explain complex technical topics in clear language that is relevant to both technical and business audiences
* Work with senior leaders to connect conversational AI investments to business priorities, customer value, productivity, and operational outcomes
* Develop trusted relationships so that teams engage early when evaluating important conversational AI opportunities or decisions
  

  

**Qualifications**

* Master's degree or doctorate in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, or a related field
* Experience working with models and platforms from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or the open source community, including agent frameworks and orchestration tooling
* Experience with machine learning operations, model evaluation, AI monitoring, or conversational AI observability tools
* Experience defining service requirements for conversational AI systems, including availability, latency, performance, monitoring, usage limits, and operational support
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices, including explainability, model documentation, evaluation, audit processes, governance, and policy implementation for conversational systems
* Experience working with research, engineering, or innovation teams to bring conversational AI capabilities into production
* Experience designing conversational AI user experiences that support transparency, consent, user review, and appropriate human control (e.g., escalation to a live agent)
* Experience in data centers, cloud infrastructure, telecommunications, or enterprise technology
* Experience building AI assistants, chatbots, voice agents, or AI-enabled conversational workflows at enterprise scale
* Experience with business software, enterprise platforms, or products designed for developers

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing form.

Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

**We use artificial intelligence in our hiring process. Learn more** **here****.**

This posting is a new position within our organization.

title: Digital Product Manager Expert - Finance Technology
job_description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a forward-thinking Digital Product Manager to lead the creation of AI-powered finance technology products that transform enterprise financial data into action. In this role you will define and deliver next-generation finance capabilities that include predictive modelling, trend analysis, risk identification, automated insight generation, and faster anomaly detection across the business,  
  
  
  
  
Working closely with Finance, Accounting, Product and Technology stakeholders, you will translate complex business challenges into scalable digital product solutions that reduce the time from insight to action and enable faster, data-driven decisions that improve financial performance and support profitable growth.

### **Key responsibilities**

* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and success measures for AI-enabled finance technology products across financial management, predictive modelling, insight generation, and anomaly detection.
* Partner with Finance, Accounting, Product and Technology teams to identify high-value business problems and convert them into prioritised product outcomes, requirements, and delivery plans.
* Lead cross-functional delivery of digital products and intelligence capabilities, ensuring solutions use modern data, cloud, analytics, and AI technologies to create measurable business value.
* Translate complex financial data, trends, risks, and opportunities into user-centred products that support faster and more informed decision-making for business leaders.
* Manage stakeholder alignment across senior business and technology audiences, influencing strategy, resolving competing priorities, and maintaining clear communication on progress and outcomes.
* Monitor product performance using agreed metrics, user feedback, and business impact measures to continuously improve adoption, usability, and time from insight to action.

**Essential Skills**

  

* Minimum 15 years’ experience in Digital Product Management, leading platform or data products, from discovery through delivery and adoption.
* Evidence of delivering strategic transformation initiatives that used data, cloud, analytics, automation, or AI technologies to improve business outcomes.
* Strong Finance, Accounting, Data, Analytics, or enterprise technology domain experience, with the ability to translate complex business problems into product roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Experience working with senior business and technology stakeholders to prioritise product backlogs, influence decisions, and deliver outcomes across cross-functional teams.

* Ability to define product success measures and use data, user feedback, and performance indicators to assess value, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Experience delivering AI-powered, machine learning, predictive analytics, or automated insight products within Finance, Accounting, Risk, or enterprise data environments.
* Knowledge of financial performance management, forecasting, scenario modelling, financial controls, or anomaly detection use cases.
* Experience with agile product delivery practices including discovery, roadmap planning, user story definition, backlog management, and iterative release planning.
* Exposure to enterprise data platforms, cloud-based analytics environments, business intelligence solutions, or data governance considerations.
* Product management certification, agile certification, or relevant qualification in business, finance, data, technology, or product management.

**Primary Skills**

Business Case Analyses, Digital Product Management, Product Management, Product Roadmapping, Product Strategies, Systems Thinking

**Shift Time**

**Recruiter Info**

Hiral Parag Rughanihparb@allstate.com

**About Allstate**

**Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.**

The Allstate Corporation is one of the largest publicly held insurance providers in the United States. Ranked No. 84 in the 2023 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations by total revenue, The Allstate Corporation owns and operates 18 companies in the United States, Canada, Northern Ireland, and India. Allstate India Private Limited, also known as Allstate India, is a subsidiary of The Allstate Corporation. The India talent center was set up in 2012 and operates under the corporation's Good Hands promise. As it innovates operations and technology, Allstate India has evolved beyond its technology functions to be the critical strategic business services arm of the corporation. With offices in Bengaluru and Pune, the company offers expertise to the parent organization’s business areas including technology and innovation, accounting and imaging services, policy administration, transformation solution design and support services, transformation of property liability service design, global operations and integration, and training and transition.

Learn more about Allstate India here.

Overview:

### **ABOUT XACTLY**

### **Xactly is the global leader in AI-driven Sales Performance Orchestration. We help enterprise organizations align revenue strategy with execution — connecting planning, incentives, and performance in one Intelligent Revenue Platform. Trusted by industry leading companies worldwide, Xactly empowers sales teams to perform at their peak.**

### **THE OPPORTUNITY –**

### **Senior Product Manager In this role, you will be part of a lively, high-performing Product Management team that shapes the future of Xactly’s AI-powered application ecosystem. You will collaborate closely with User Experience professionals, engineering teams, and clients to discover innovative solutions, solve complex challenges, and contribute to delivering high-impact product outcomes for customers and stakeholders.**

### **WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* **Lead concurrent product initiatives and agile scrum rituals by defining requirements, grooming the product backlog, and translating user needs into actionable units of work for the development team.**
* **Partner directly with external clients, Customer Success, and Implementation teams to conduct user research, validate product concepts, and drive continuous product innovation.**
* **Define and track key product performance metrics, performing deep-dive quantitative analyses to identify areas for improvement and present strategic recommendations to stakeholders.**
* **Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned functional areas, including triaging bugs, prioritizing feature requests, and refining test plans in collaboration with Engineering.**

### **WHAT YOU’LL BRING**

### **Must-Have Skills**

### **8+ years of product management experience in the enterprise SaaS industry, supported by a foundational understanding of software development and web-based technologies. Hands-on experience managing Product Functions, App Ecosystems, and AI initiatives, alongside intermediate proficiency in SQL. Proven track record of working directly with external clients and cross-functional internal teams to gather requirements and drive product strategy. Strong analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.**

### **Good-to-Have Skills**

* **Prior experience building or managing incentive compensation management (ICM) applications.**
* **Previous hands-on engineering experience or a related technical degree.**

### **WHY XACTLY BENEFITS AND PERKS**

* **Competitive base salary + performance-based incentive**
* **Comprehensive insurance coverage**
* **Flexible time off and sick days**
* **Short-term disability, long-term disability, maternity and parental leave**
* **Gym/fitness reimbursement and tuition reimbursement**
* **Flexible savings account & Health savings account**
* **Paid holidays and up to 3 days paid community and volunteer leave**
* **Life and AD&D insurance.**
* **401(k) Retirement Savings Plan**
* **Access to wellness programs**
* **Employee discount program**
* **Additional voluntary benefits such as pet insurance, critical illness, accident insurance, hospital indemnity, and legal plan**

### **OUR VISION: To power the revenue engine of the companies changing the world.**

### **OUR CORE VALUES:**

### **Customer Focus | Accountability | Respect | Excellence (CARE) are the keys to our success, and each day we’re committed to upholding them by delivering the best we can to our customers.**

### **Xactly is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Xactly provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law. This means we believe in celebrating diversity and creating an inclusive workplace environment, where everyone feels valued, heard, and has a sense of belonging. By doing this, everyone in the Xactly family has the power to make a difference and unleash their full potential.**

### **We do not accept resumes from agencies, headhunters, or other suppliers who have not signed a formal agreement with us.**

job_description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for GSK's wireless and local area network product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs, and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered, and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology, engineering or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering).
* Agile or product certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Product ownership in a platform or agile environment, covering backlog management, prioritisation and increment acceptance.
* Outcome measurement, covering OKRs, adoption metrics and flow metrics used to steer delivery.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 5 or more years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context.
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.
* Experience delivering local area network or wireless capabilities as a Product Owner or equivalent member of an Agile team.
* Capability in Team Backlog prioritisation, story definition, acceptance criteria, Planning Interval events and iteration execution.
* Evidence of delivering campus network improvements that increased coverage, user experience or reliability.

**Desirable Requirements**

* Product Owner qualification, such as SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager or Certified Scrum Product Owner.
* Experience with Cisco Catalyst, Meraki, Juniper EX or Juniper Mist.
* Experience with network assurance, Internet of Things or operational technology connectivity.

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.
* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.
* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.
* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.
* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standards grounds.

**Skills**

Automation Technology, Backlog Prioritization, Backlogs, Cisco LAN, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Product Ownership, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Wi Fi Networking, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: AGM- Product Manager
job_description:
**ABOUT US:**

BYLD Group is committed to making a difference to people and their organizations through its decades of excellence in business solutions, diverse corporate exposure, and skilled workforce. Our clients across various industries believe us in managing, developing, and aligning their corporate needs with their organizational goals and objectives.

Founded in the year 1998, BYLD is the largest group in the South Asian region, offering technology-enabled HR and business productivity solutions. We have served 5,00,000+ individuals, worked with more than 50% of the Fortune 500 and over 60% of the Business World top 1000 companies.

Please read about us – http://byldgroup.com

**Designation -** AGM / GM - Product Manager

**Experience -** 6-8 years

**Location -** Gurgaon, Haryana

**Job Description:**
--------------------

We are looking for an Assistant General Manager / General Manager – Product Management to own BYLD Group's staffing product. The business is operations-heavy, with many internal and client stakeholders. You will use AI and automation to improve how the end-to-end staffing process runs, ship new features, and drive their adoption.

This role carries end-to-end ownership of product outcomes. You will work directly with business stakeholders, engineering and operations, and are expected to design AI-enabled workflows and architecture, prototype them hands-on, and see them through to launch.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**
-----------------------------

* **Product ownership:** Own the roadmap, prioritization and delivery for the staffing platform, balancing business impact, effort and urgency as priorities change.
* **AI and workflow architecture:** Map the end-to-end staffing workflow, identify where AI and automation add the most value, and define how they are embedded into the platform architecture. Work with engineering on data flow, integrations, accuracy targets, fallbacks and human-in-the-loop checks.
* **Efficiency and automation:** Set measurable targets (turnaround time, recruiter productivity, cost per placement), decide what to build, buy or automate with no-code tools, and prototype quickly before committing engineering time.
* **New features and adoption:** Define and launch new features with operations users, track adoption, close the feedback loop, and retire what is not used.
* **Product opportunities:** Identify gaps across client-facing, candidate-facing and internal workflows and turn them into prioritized, evidence-backed proposals.
* **Stakeholder management:** Run a single intake and triage process for requests from operations, sales, delivery and leadership. Make trade-offs visible and communicate changes early.
* **Requirements and PRDs:** Extract clear requirements from non-technical users and write PRDs that engineering can build against.
* **Sprint execution:** Work with engineering to plan and run sprints, track scope, dependencies and timelines, and unblock issues as they arise.
* **Product operations:** Own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the product function: backlog hygiene, release coordination and checklists, sprint reporting, and regular status updates to stakeholders. Standardize PRD, sprint and release templates so execution stays consistent as the team scales.
* **Metrics and reporting:** Track operational efficiency and product metrics (sprint velocity, release health, feature adoption), analyse NPS, support tickets and feature requests, and report outcomes to leadership.
* **Design collaboration:** Brief the in-house designer, review output against the original ask, and use AI design tools for mock-ups when design support is unavailable.
* **Tooling and onboarding:** Own and maintain the product tooling stack (project management, design, analytics, feedback), keep its data clean, document processes

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 6–8 years in Product Management or Product Operations, ideally in staffing, recruitment tech, HR-tech or other operations-heavy B2B platforms.
* Hands-on product operations experience: backlog management, release coordination, sprint reporting, stakeholder status updates, and building templates and processes that scale.
* Proven ability to improve operational efficiency with AI and automation, with measurable results (hours saved, turnaround time reduced).
* Clear understanding of how to embed AI into a product architecture: where LLMs, OCR and document intelligence, and rules-based automation each fit, how to measure accuracy, and how to design fallbacks.
* Hands-on builder: you create working automations, agents or prototypes yourself with LLM, workflow or AI coding tools.
* Strong stakeholder management across many senior stakeholders with conflicting priorities, and comfort with rapid change.
* Ability to map operational workflows, find bottlenecks and convert them into product requirements.
* Experience writing PRDs and working with engineering through the sprint cycle.
* Experience launching features and driving adoption using product analytics and user feedback.
* Comfortable working with designers: clear briefs and structured feedback.
* Structured, detail-oriented approach to documentation, and excellent written and verbal communication.

**Technical Requirements:**
---------------------------

* **AI architecture:** LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval (RAG), agents, evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design, plus cost, latency and data privacy trade-offs.
* **Workflow and integration tools:** n8n, Zapier, Make or similar; APIs, webhooks and integrations with ATS, CRM and VMS systems.
* **AI coding tools:** Active working knowledge of Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to prototype, debug or ship small changes independently.
* **Architecture basics:** APIs, databases, queues and how web and mobile applications are built, enough for informed conversations with engineering.
* **Product and project management:** Jira, Linear, Asana, Trello or similar; Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace.
* **Design and prototyping:** Figma (or similar) and AI design tools such as Figma AI or Uizard.
* **Analytics and reporting:** Mixpanel, Amplitude or Google Analytics dashboards; strong Excel / Sheets.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with ATS, CRM or VMS platforms and the staffing lifecycle.
* Experience building or launching AI agents or AI-powered product features.
* Familiarity with data privacy and statutory compliance in Indian staffing (e.g. DPDP Act, onboarding documentation).
* Exposure to no-code / low-code tools for internal tooling.

**Why join BYLD:**

**Perks & Benefits:**

* Learn directly from industry experts with 20+ years of experience
* Opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
* Professional development and growth opportunities.
* Gain experience in world class management practices
* Insurance Benefits (Medical and Accidental) for all employees
* Multi-level Rewards programs for all employees

**Follow us:**

– https://linkedin.com/company/byld-group

– https://facebook.com/BYLDGroup

– https://twitter.com/BYLDGroup

* **Product operations:** Own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the product function: backlog hygiene, release coordination and checklists, sprint reporting, and regular status updates to stakeholders. Standardize PRD, sprint and release templates so execution stays consistent as the team scales.
* **Metrics and reporting:** Track operational efficiency and product metrics (sprint velocity, release health, feature adoption), analyse NPS, support tickets and feature requests, and report outcomes to leadership.
* **Design collaboration:** Brief the in-house designer, review output against the original ask, and use AI design tools for mock-ups when design support is unavailable.
* **Tooling and onboarding:** Own and maintain the product tooling stack (project management, design, analytics, feedback), keep its data clean, document processes

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* 6–8 years in Product Management or Product Operations, ideally in staffing, recruitment tech, HR-tech or other operations-heavy B2B platforms.
* Hands-on product operations experience: backlog management, release coordination, sprint reporting, stakeholder status updates, and building templates and processes that scale.
* Proven ability to improve operational efficiency with AI and automation, with measurable results (hours saved, turnaround time reduced).
* Clear understanding of how to embed AI into a product architecture: where LLMs, OCR and document intelligence, and rules-based automation each fit, how to measure accuracy, and how to design fallbacks.
* Hands-on builder: you create working automations, agents or prototypes yourself with LLM, workflow or AI coding tools.
* Strong stakeholder management across many senior stakeholders with conflicting priorities, and comfort with rapid change.
* Ability to map operational workflows, find bottlenecks and convert them into product requirements.
* Experience writing PRDs and working with engineering through the sprint cycle.
* Experience launching features and driving adoption using product analytics and user feedback.
* Comfortable working with designers: clear briefs and structured feedback.
* Structured, detail-oriented approach to documentation, and excellent written and verbal communication.

**Technical Requirements:**
---------------------------

* **AI architecture:** LLM APIs, prompt design, retrieval (RAG), agents, evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design, plus cost, latency and data privacy trade-offs.
* **Workflow and integration tools:** n8n, Zapier, Make or similar; APIs, webhooks and integrations with ATS, CRM and VMS systems.
* **AI coding tools:** Active working knowledge of Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to prototype, debug or ship small changes independently.
* **Architecture basics:** APIs, databases, queues and how web and mobile applications are built, enough for informed conversations with engineering.
* **Product and project management:** Jira, Linear, Asana, Trello or similar; Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace.
* **Design and prototyping:** Figma (or similar) and AI design tools such as Figma AI or Uizard.
* **Analytics and reporting:** Mixpanel, Amplitude or Google Analytics dashboards; strong Excel / Sheets.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience with ATS, CRM or VMS platforms and the staffing lifecycle.
* Experience building or launching AI agents or AI-powered product features.
* Familiarity with data privacy and statutory compliance in Indian staffing (e.g. DPDP Act, onboarding documentation).
* Exposure to no-code / low-code tools for internal tooling.

**Perks & Benefits:**

* Learn directly from industry experts with 20+ years of experience
* Opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment.
* Professional development and growth opportunities.
* Gain experience in world class management practices
* Insurance Benefits (Medical and Accidental) for all employees
* Multi-level Rewards programs for all employees

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in “Data Product Ownership, AI Automation, and Data Quality Engineering”. You have found the right team.

As “Data Product Ownership, AI Automation, and Data Quality Engineering Professional / Lead” within our “Asset & Wealth Management – MPX Account Management Services (Account SOR)” , you will be responsible for setting and improving our organizational objectives, and ensuring their consistent accomplishment.

Job Responsibilities

* **Lead** the Operate function for Account Management Services by owning day-to-day product stability, service delivery, and BAU point-of-contact coverage.
* **Partner** with stakeholders across Operations, Technology, and Service Management to triage, prioritize, and resolve tickets, incidents, defects, and urgent ad-hoc requests with clear SLAs and communications.
* **Translate** recurring BAU issues and user feedback into product enhancements by defining requirements, acceptance criteria, and release plans to improve user/client experience.
* **Establish** operating rhythms and performance metrics (e.g., ticket trends, root-cause themes, time-to-resolution) to drive continuous improvement and proactive risk/controls management.
* **Define** crisp problem statements, use cases, user journeys, success metrics, and acceptance criteria from complex requirements to enable fast, rigorous delivery.
* **Drive** the modernization roadmap across platform evolution, user experience improvements, and scalable operational processes.
* **Identify** AI and Agentic AI opportunities that increase straight-through processing and data quality with safe, explainable, and governable designs.
* **Partner** across Business, Operations, Technology, and Controls to remove blockers, force decisions, and accelerate delivery outcomes.
* **Sequence** work across teams, platforms, and release trains to manage dependencies and deliver predictable, high-quality releases.
* **Stand up** delivery and outcome metrics (quality, timeliness, adoption, STP lift, defect reduction, cycle time) to continuously reshape priorities and the roadmap.
* **Own** the product vision, roadmap, and execution for mission-critical data services powering onboarding, reporting, operational workflows, and investment processes.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

* **Demonstrate** a proven track record as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Delivery Lead for data products, platforms, or critical enterprise services (ideally in a major financial institution).
* **Bring** a minimum of 10 years of Financial Services experience blending data, technology, and operations with Asset & Wealth Management data concepts.
* **Deliver** effectively in agile environments with backlog discipline, pragmatic scope control, and outcome-based execution.
* **Work** hands-on with SQL and Python to navigate large datasets, validate hypotheses, investigate issues, and partner credibly with engineering and analytics.
* **Apply** practical fluency with AI and Agentic AI for data products (e.g., reconciliations, anomaly detection, triage, metadata enrichment, exception handling, workflow orchestration) while evaluating value, risk, scalability, and controls.
* **Influence** stakeholders at every level with sharp written and verbal communication suitable for governance forums and senior leadership.
* **Hold** a minimum of a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, or a related field.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

* **Bring** Asset Management experience with onboarding and servicing.
* **Use** foundational AI/developer tooling such as VS Code and GitHub Copilot within a modern engineering environment.
* **Show** familiarity with data-quality tooling, metadata platforms, lineage frameworks, and modern data platforms (lakehouse/warehouse patterns, distributed processing, APIs, and data services).
* **Earn** product management certifications such as CSPO or PSPO (preferred).
* **Hold** a Master's degree in engineering or computer science and demonstrate a creative mindset for innovative data-solution design.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

J.P. Morgan Asset & Wealth Management delivers industry-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

* Experience with configurable products, workflows, platforms, APIs or integrations.
* Strong problem-solving and product judgment.
* Experience in HRTech / ATS is a plus
* Good communication skills and ability to work with customers and cross-functional teams.

title: Associate Director - Product Owner - LES
job_description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**

The Product Owner is responsible for maximising the value, compliance, adoption, and operational performance of the LabWare Lab Execution System (LES) used to digitise and control QC laboratory test execution. The role translates QC, Quality, site, and regulatory needs into a prioritised LabWare LES backlog and leads delivery across the product lifecycle within strategic, financial, architectural, and GxP guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead. The Product Owner works closely with laboratory stakeholders, Quality, CSV, Tech, suppliers, and delivery teams to ensure LabWare LES capabilities are usable, validated, secure, supportable, inspection-ready, and aligned to standardised laboratory execution processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with QC laboratory, Quality, site, and digital stakeholders to understand laboratory execution needs and define LabWare LES outcomes that improve compliance, data integrity, analyst experience, and operational efficiency.
* Own and manage the LabWare LES product backlog, ensuring epics, features, user stories, configuration needs, master data impacts, reporting requirements, validation expectations, and dependencies are clearly defined and prioritised.
* Make backlog prioritisation decisions based on GxP impact, business value, laboratory criticality, data integrity risk, defect severity, release capacity, cost, and cross-site standardisation opportunities, escalating strategic trade-offs to the Product Manager or Product Domain Lead.
* Lead delivery activities for LabWare LES changes, guiding Product Analysts, configuration specialists, testers, CSV resources, architects, engineers, and supplier teams to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, validated, secure, supportable, and aligned to architecture and quality standards.
* Ensure LabWare LES changes support controlled laboratory execution, including electronic worksheets, procedural step guidance, calculations, specifications, instrument or system interfaces, review-by-exception, audit trails, electronic signatures, and exception handling where applicable.
* Drive operational readiness by ensuring support model impacts, SOP updates, training materials, release communications, cutover plans, hypercare, runbooks, and knowledge transfer are in place before deployment.
* Maintain product performance measures for LabWare LES, including adoption, release throughput, defects, incident trends, validation progress, user experience signals, support effort, and benefits realisation; use insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes comply with GxP, CSV, data integrity, security, privacy, access control, change control, and supplier governance expectations, obtaining input and approvals from Quality, CSV, Security, Architecture, and other SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects and technical teams in assessing design options, integrations, environment management, reporting, performance, and dependencies with LIMS, instruments, ERP, document management, identity management, and other connected systems.
* Act as an escalation point for LabWare LES functional issues, defects, prioritisation conflicts, and release readiness decisions, balancing business continuity, compliance risk, user impact, and delivery capacity.
* Promote agile, iterative, value-driven delivery practices while maintaining the discipline required for validated systems, including traceability from requirements through design, build, testing, approval, release, and ongoing periodic review.

**Basic Requirements:**

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Life Sciences or related field (or equivalent experience).

* Typically 5+ years of experience in product delivery, laboratory informatics, LabWare LIMS / LES, QC laboratory systems, or process-led technology roles in a regulated environment.
* Proven experience defining, prioritising, and delivering requirements for laboratory execution, LIMS / LES, electronic worksheets, analytical workflows, reporting, interfaces, or validated laboratory systems.
* Experience working directly with QC laboratories, Quality, CSV, IT, suppliers, and site stakeholders to translate laboratory needs into feasible, compliant, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on GxP impact, data integrity risk, user impact, business continuity, technical complexity, cost, and delivery capacity.
* Experience supporting validated system delivery, including requirements, configuration, testing, defect triage, release readiness, change control, and deployment into controlled laboratory environments.
* Familiarity with regulated change management, periodic review, audit trail review expectations, user access governance, supplier management, and quality documentation for GxP systems.
* Exposure to continuous improvement approaches that simplify laboratory processes, reduce manual transcription, improve right-first-time execution, and increase adoption of standardised digital laboratory ways of working.
* Experience working within agile or hybrid delivery environments while maintaining appropriate validation, traceability, and release controls for regulated systems.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Process Diagrams, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. **About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**

The Product Owner is responsible for maximising the value, compliance, adoption, and operational performance of the LabWare Lab Execution System (LES) used to digitise and control QC laboratory test execution. The role translates QC, Quality, site, and regulatory needs into a prioritised LabWare LES backlog and leads delivery across the product lifecycle within strategic, financial, architectural, and GxP guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead. The Product Owner works closely with laboratory stakeholders, Quality, CSV, Tech, suppliers, and delivery teams to ensure LabWare LES capabilities are usable, validated, secure, supportable, inspection-ready, and aligned to standardised laboratory execution processes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Partner with QC laboratory, Quality, site, and digital stakeholders to understand laboratory execution needs and define LabWare LES outcomes that improve compliance, data integrity, analyst experience, and operational efficiency.
* Own and manage the LabWare LES product backlog, ensuring epics, features, user stories, configuration needs, master data impacts, reporting requirements, validation expectations, and dependencies are clearly defined and prioritised.
* Make backlog prioritisation decisions based on GxP impact, business value, laboratory criticality, data integrity risk, defect severity, release capacity, cost, and cross-site standardisation opportunities, escalating strategic trade-offs to the Product Manager or Product Domain Lead.
* Lead delivery activities for LabWare LES changes, guiding Product Analysts, configuration specialists, testers, CSV resources, architects, engineers, and supplier teams to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, validated, secure, supportable, and aligned to architecture and quality standards.
* Ensure LabWare LES changes support controlled laboratory execution, including electronic worksheets, procedural step guidance, calculations, specifications, instrument or system interfaces, review-by-exception, audit trails, electronic signatures, and exception handling where applicable.
* Drive operational readiness by ensuring support model impacts, SOP updates, training materials, release communications, cutover plans, hypercare, runbooks, and knowledge transfer are in place before deployment.
* Maintain product performance measures for LabWare LES, including adoption, release throughput, defects, incident trends, validation progress, user experience signals, support effort, and benefits realisation; use insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Ensure product changes comply with GxP, CSV, data integrity, security, privacy, access control, change control, and supplier governance expectations, obtaining input and approvals from Quality, CSV, Security, Architecture, and other SMEs where required.
* Support Solution Architects and technical teams in assessing design options, integrations, environment management, reporting, performance, and dependencies with LIMS, instruments, ERP, document management, identity management, and other connected systems.
* Act as an escalation point for LabWare LES functional issues, defects, prioritisation conflicts, and release readiness decisions, balancing business continuity, compliance risk, user impact, and delivery capacity.
* Promote agile, iterative, value-driven delivery practices while maintaining the discipline required for validated systems, including traceability from requirements through design, build, testing, approval, release, and ongoing periodic review.

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Life Sciences or related field (or equivalent experience).

* Typically 5+ years of experience in product delivery, laboratory informatics, LabWare LIMS / LES, QC laboratory systems, or process-led technology roles in a regulated environment.
* Proven experience defining, prioritising, and delivering requirements for laboratory execution, LIMS / LES, electronic worksheets, analytical workflows, reporting, interfaces, or validated laboratory systems.
* Experience working directly with QC laboratories, Quality, CSV, IT, suppliers, and site stakeholders to translate laboratory needs into feasible, compliant, value-led technology changes.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on GxP impact, data integrity risk, user impact, business continuity, technical complexity, cost, and delivery capacity.

* Familiarity with regulated change management, periodic review, audit trail review expectations, user access governance, supplier management, and quality documentation for GxP systems.

Associate Product Manager

Associate Product Manager Bikham, India — Remote We are seeking a highly motivated and intellectually curious Associate Product Manager (APM) to join our growing team. This is an exciting opportunity for an aspiring product leader who is eager to make a significant impact in the US Health Tech space. As an APM, you will play a crucial role in bringing our B2B product vision to life. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, sales, and customer success, to understand user needs, define product requirements, and deliver intuitive, technically sound solutions. A strong understanding of user experience principles and a solid technical foundation are essential, as you'll be navigating complex healthcare workflows and translating them into elegant product features. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and demonstrates an exceptional ability to learn, adapt, and drive initiatives forward. Key Responsibilities • Product Lifecycle Support: Assist in defining product requirements, writing user stories, and managing the product backlog for specific features or modules. • Technical Understanding: Bridge the gap between business needs and technical feasibility, working closely with engineers to understand system capabilities and limitations, and ensuring technical solutions align with product goals. • Market & Competitor Analysis: Support market research efforts to identify trends, competitive landscapes, and opportunities within the US Health Tech credentialing and provider management sector. • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among engineering, design, sales, marketing, and customer success teams throughout the product development lifecycle. • Data-Driven Decisions: Assist in tracking product performance metrics, analyzing data, and gathering insights to inform product iterations and future strategies. • Stakeholder Communication: Help prepare product updates and communicate progress to internal and external stakeholders. • Learning & Adaptability: Proactively seek out new knowledge, adapt to evolving priorities, and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and innovation. What We're Looking For • Experience: Approximately 2 years of experience in product management, business analysis, software development, or a related role, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment. • User Empathy: A strong passion for understanding user needs and a keen eye for user experience design principles. • Technical Aptitude: Demonstrated ability to understand technical concepts, engage with engineers, and contribute to discussions about system architecture and implementation. • Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex problems into manageable solutions. Page 1 • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of articulating complex ideas clearly and concisely to diverse audiences. • Collaboration: A collaborative spirit with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment. • Curiosity & Drive: A self-starter with a strong desire to learn, grow, and take initiative in a dynamic startup setting. • Education: We prioritize your ability to deliver outstanding results and your practical understanding of Product Landscape. While a formal degree can be helpful, it is not a strict requirement if you can demonstrate your capabilities. Bonus Points • Experience in the US healthcare industry or health tech. • Familiarity with credentialing, privileging, or provider management processes. • Experience with product analytics tools

**Team Overview**

The Product TPM team operates at the intersection of business, technology, and delivery, enabling the successful development and rollout of scalable, customer-centric solutions. At the Consultant (P03) level, the team is composed of Technical Product Managers who own feature-level delivery while collaborating closely with engineering, design, and business stakeholders.
  
The team functions within an Agile framework, ensuring continuous delivery of high-quality product increments through iterative development, sprint cycles, and regular feedback loops. Each TPM is responsible for managing specific product modules or features, contributing to the broader product roadmap while aligning execution with organizational goals and customer needs.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

**1. Product Ownership**

* Own and manage assigned product features or modules from concept to delivery
* Define detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and maintain the product backlog
* Prioritize deliverables based on business value, customer impact, and feasibility

**2. Product Strategy & Roadmap Support**

* Contribute to product roadmap planning and execution
* Align feature development with overall product vision and business objectives
* Incorporate stakeholder input, user feedback, and analytics insights

**3. Technical Collaboration**

* Translate business requirements into clear technical specifications
* Work closely with engineering teams on solution design and implementation
* Assess technical trade-offs, dependencies, and constraints
* Ensure adherence to scalability, security, and performance standards

**4. Agile Delivery Execution**

* Actively participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, grooming, stand-ups, retrospectives)
* Ensure timely and high-quality delivery of product increments
* Support continuous improvement in development and delivery processes

**5. Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with business, engineering, and UX/design teams
* Act as the primary point of contact for owned features
* Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes effectively

**6. Data-Driven Decision Making**

* Define and track KPIs for product features
* Use product analytics and user insights to drive improvements
* Optimize product performance, usability, and adoption

**7. Product Lifecycle Support**

* Support the full product lifecycle including requirement gathering, development, testing, and release
* Assist in documentation, training, and user adoption initiatives
Ensure smooth rollout and continuous enhancement of features  

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

  
  

The Technical Platform Manager (TPM) is responsible for driving the strategy, roadmap, adoption, governance, and delivery of enterprise platform services that enable secure, scalable, and efficient software development and infrastructure operations across the organization.

  

This role partners with platform service owners, engineering leaders, architecture, security, compliance, cloud engineering, and application development teams to define platform capabilities, establish operational excellence standards, drive platform adoption, and deliver measurable business outcomes. The TPM serves as a strategic leader who balances platform scalability, reliability, security, developer experience, and cost optimization while ensuring enterprise platform services continue to meet evolving business and technology needs.

  

Platform domains may include Data Ingestion, Data Quality, ETL, Web Applications, Observability, Infrastructure Automation, PKI and Certificate Lifecycle Management , Developer Tooling, and Internal Developer Platforms.

  

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.

* Strong understanding of enterprise data ecosystems including: Data AcquisitionData IngestionData Quality ManagementData Correction WorkflowsMaster Data ManagementData DistributionData Governance
* Experience working with both real-time and batch processing architectures.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise data architecture patterns including: Event-driven architectureStreaming platformsData pipelinesAPI-driven integrationsData products
* Experience managing products supporting multiple internal and external customers.
* Experience establishing and reporting product KPIs and operational metrics.
* Proven ability to influence executive leadership, engineering organizations, and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated success delivering large-scale, highly regulated, enterprise data initiatives.
* Strong ownership mindset with experience managing risks, dependencies, and commitments across multiple delivery teams.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Enterprise Data Platforms and Data Warehousing concepts.
* Data Ingestion Technologies including: KafkaCDC PlatformsStreaming SolutionsETL/ELT FrameworksEvent-Driven Architectures
* Enterprise databases including: PostgreSQLSQL ServerOracleNoSQL Technologies
* Caching and low-latency data access platforms: RedisDistributed Caching PlatformsIn-memory Data Technologies
* API Management and Data Services: RESTgRPCEvent APIsData Service Layers
* Cloud platforms: AWSAzureGCP
* Data Quality and Observability platforms.
* Data Governance, Metadata Management, and Data Lineage concepts.
* Agile delivery tools including Jira, Confluence, and enterprise planning platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting enterprise credit, risk, fraud, identity, or financial data ecosystems.
* Knowledge of consumer, commercial, fraud, or alternative data acquisition and fulfilment processes.
* Experience with data correction and dispute management platforms.
* Experience with Data Mesh, Data Product, or Data-as-a-Service operating models.
* Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks governing data management and consumer information.
* Experience leading enterprise data modernization, cloud migration, or platform transformation initiatives.
* Experience presenting platform strategy, data quality trends, adoption metrics, and business outcomes to senior executive leadership.
* Strong understanding of data operations, service reliability, and operational excellence practices.
  

  

**TransUnion Overview:**

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our **Workforce for Good** , which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.

  

Be a part of our **Workforce for Good** – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

job_description:
Experience: 1–3 years  
Location: Bengaluru (Work from Office – Domlur)

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an Associate Product Manager who is proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited about building AI-first products.

You should be someone who takes ownership, figures things out independently, and enjoys solving problems. We value people who can move fast, experiment, and get things done without needing constant direction.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own product initiatives end-to-end, from identifying problems to launching solutions and measuring impact.
* Work on AI-first products, identifying opportunities to use GenAI and automation to improve user experience and business outcomes.
* Conduct customer research, understand user pain points, and translate insights into product improvements.
* Work closely with Engineering, Design, and Business teams to build and ship products.
* Define and track product metrics, analyze funnels, and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Build quick prototypes, test ideas, and iterate based on feedback and data.
* Contribute to product strategy and roadmap discussions.

### **What We're Looking For**

* Education: Bachelor's degree from a Tier 1 institution, preferably in Engineering or a technical discipline.
* Experience: 1–3 years in Product Management, Engineering, Analytics, or related roles.
* High agency: Someone who takes initiative, works independently, and finds ways to get things done.
* AI-first mindset: Actively uses AI tools in day-to-day work and is curious about building products using AI.
* Problem-solving: Strong analytical skills and the ability to break down ambiguous problems.
* Product sense: Good understanding of user experience and what makes a product work well.
* Communication: Ability to communicate clearly and work with different teams.

### **Good to Have**

* Experience building AI agents, prototypes, or side projects using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or Replit.
* Experience with consumer products, growth, or monetisation.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, SEO, or digital marketing.
* Previous startup or 01 product experience.

We are particularly interested in people who have built something on their own, whether it's a side project, a small product, or an AI-powered tool. We care about what you've done, not just the roles you've held.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Lead - AI
job_description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Oversight** **& Best Practices:** Optimize product management processes, employing AI where possible and proactively identify areas for standardization and improved efficiency (e.g. Service Descriptions), document and implement.
* **Roadmap Support**: Oversee process for product managers in developing and managing roadmaps; coordinating feedback for process improvements, and preparing client and senior management-ready roadmap views near on-demand.
* **Governance Coordination**: Support execution of annual **Wealth Investment Governance Board** by defining and coordinating PM driven templates, supporting content creation, execute logistics and run of show and following up on actions.
* **Strategic Support**: Opportunity to contribute to ad hoc strategic client or internal projects and initiatives as directed by Senior Management, such as documentation and coordination across product for Strat Planning, Growth Day and Client Sales Opportunities.
* **AI:** Assist teams in utilizing BR AI tools to capture valuable product insights that support their strategies and client adoption. Contributing to and supporting the Wealth AI task force, and ideating on new innovations to support the COE and managing reporting and metrics.

**What Success Looks Like:**

  

* Implemented Service Description workflow and attestation process, including coordinated legal updates and tracking of common elements.
* Ability to produce on-demand roadmaps by product or Wealth overall as required both from clients and internally
* Efficiently executed internal events that impact and advance our strategic Wealth initiatives, providing clear actions and follow ups with stakeholders and clients.
* Become a Go-To Product COE expert in support of our Product teams, ensuring their success in delivering high quality roadmaps, ideas and processes.
* Delivery of well documented processes and best practices available to all associates, maintained and updated consistently
* AI driven process ideation and implementation of our product management process, creating efficiencies and best practices adopted across the COE.

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

**Use of AI in Hiring**

As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Owner - Tax Reporting
job_description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

Product Owner/ Business Analyst – Tax Reporting  
Experience: 3 to 6 Years Job Requisition: TBD  
About the Role  
We’re seeking a Business Analyst / Product Owner with strong expertise in U.S. tax reporting and securities processing. You’ll act as the bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, ensuring our products meet complex IRS requirements while driving operational efficiency for global clients. This role combines product ownership, business analysis, and Agile/Scrum leadership to deliver impactful financial solutions.  
Key Responsibilities  

Product Ownership  
Define and prioritize product backlog items with a focus on IRS/regulatory compliance (cost basis, income reclassification, tax form production).  
Act as Product Owner in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, ensuring clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and alignment with business goals.  

Agile & Scrum Delivery  
Collaborate with Scrum Masters and development teams to drive sprint planning, backlog refinement, and timely delivery.  
Champion Agile practices, fostering transparency, adaptability, and continuous improvement across teams.  

Cross-Functional Collaboration  
Partner with Development, QA teams across geographies to deliver scalable, compliant solutions.  
Facilitate workshops, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to align stakeholders and ensure shared understanding of product goals.  

Client Engagement  
Work directly with clients and partners to capture reporting needs, regulatory changes, and operational challenges.  
Translate complex tax and securities requirements into actionable user stories and product features.  

Domain Expertise  
Apply deep knowledge of IRS/regulatory practices, withholding, corporate actions, and back-office operations.  
Ensure solutions meet tax reporting/regulatory standards with accuracy, reliability, and audit readiness.  
Qualifications  

Hands-on industry experience in U.S. Tax Reporting and Securities Processing.  

Strong knowledge of IRS requirements for cost basis, income, withholding, and form production.  

Experience with back-office platforms (BPS, BETA preferred).  

Demonstrated success working in Agile/Scrum environments as a Product Owner or Business Analyst.  

Technical expertise in SQL, PostgreSQL, and Power BI for advanced data analysis, reporting, and visualization.  

Strong communication abilities, adept at engaging with clients and stakeholders.  

Education: BE / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent.  

Flexibility to work in rotational shifts when required.

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work.
